hf.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
hf.abstract: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.
hf.titleZh: OR-License：评估 LLM Agent 作为真实世界的运筹学从业者
hf.summaryZh: 现有运筹学（OR）benchmark多以自包含题面或预设优化任务起步，忽略了把原始商业材料转化为专业可用方案的过程。OR-License构建端到端基准：素材取自总价368万美元的付费OR项目，覆盖10个工业场景共31个实例，保留原始需求、输入数据、交付格式与信息边界，并配ORSim受控客户模拟器考察信息获取；以部署调整质量（DAQ）对不可行交付记零分。11个前沿LLM在coding-agent harness下评测，部分模型的条件目标质量超过专家参考，但无人追平专家DAQ 1.0（最强Claude Code配置严格可行率88.39%、DAQ 0.87），任务对齐的完整研究链完成率仅24%–45%。
hf.reason: Agent真实任务端到端评测，含客户模拟器与长程轨迹分析

hf.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
hf.abstract: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.
hf.titleZh: 将参数高效微调扩展到大脑编码
hf.summaryZh: 脑编码模型多采用冻结预训练骨干加读出层的做法，而神经数据昂贵稀缺，从头训练或全量微调大模型难以走通。工作以LoRA加轻量读出层适配最多104B参数的多模态骨干，并利用骨干的因果结构单次预测多个时间点以替代滑窗，大幅降低特征提取开销；同时开发multi-LoRA内核，加速共享骨干上多个LoRA的联合训练。方法在九个多模态骨干上一致提升脑编码性能，在与此前SoTA相同的Qwen3-Omni骨干上于Algonauts 2025挑战赛取得最佳公开成绩，200+模型集成在公开post-challenge榜单排名第一，且模态归因仍能恢复经典感觉拓扑。结果表明PEFT可作为脑编码的高效适配范式。
hf.reason: 脑编码属垂直应用，但104B PEFT与multi-LoRA内核有工程参考价值

hf.title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
hf.abstract: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
hf.titleZh: EgoXperience：从人类经验中学习世界锚定的自我中心表征
hf.summaryZh: 第一人称视频中，相机运动、场景几何与手物交互需在同一世界坐标系下保持一致，而现有方法与数据难以同时支持联合重建与对齐监督。EgoXperience 构建了从数据采集、自动标注到统一建模与评测的全栈方案:EgoX-Engine 将几何验证的对象跟踪与 SLAM 世界对齐耦合，产出 50 小时、带秒级任务描述的数据集 EgoX-Data-6M，并从中挑选 1 小时构建 EgoX-Bench。模型 EgoX 仅输入单目第一人称视频与首帧物体掩码，单次前向即可联合重建相机、场景、手与物体的度量尺度位姿。相较最强基线，相机、手部与深度误差分别降低 68.9%、65.6%、42.9%，物体位姿分数提升 28.0%。
hf.reason: 第一人称三维重建与手物位姿估计，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
hf.abstract: Human egocentric experience offers a rich foundation for learning how the world is organized and how it changes through interaction. Realizing this potential at scale requires turning growing volumes of recordings into learning resources that connect scene structure, object semantics, and interaction histories across viewpoints and time, while reducing dependence on costly manual annotation. We introduce HOLI-WORLD, an integrated ecosystem connecting experience capture, world representation, automated data construction, model learning, and independent evaluation. To sup- port learning at scale, HOLIWORLD-Foundry combines complementary static and dynamic perception to automatically construct world records that connect persistent scene structure and evolving object states with interaction histories and supporting observations. HOLIWORLD-Data organizes these records from approximately 100 self-collected scenes into grounded learning resources, including approximately 80K QA pairs used to train HOLIWORLD-VL-4B. Independent human annotations of heldout recordings form HOLIWORLD-Bench, supporting evaluation of both annotation quality and learned spatial and temporal understanding. Experiments on ScanNet, ScanNet++, Aria Digital Twin, and HOLIWORLD-Bench demonstrate strong performance in static perception and dynamic tracking, while training on HOLIWORLD-Data substantially improves HOLIWORLD-VL-4B's spatial and temporal reasoning on HOLI- WORLD-Bench and EgoDynamic4D. HOLIWORLD provides a practical foundation for expanding learning resources from the continuous flow of human experience and advancing machine understanding of the dynamic world.
hf.titleZh: HOLI-World:从人类第一视角经验构建整体世界智能
hf.summaryZh: 针对第一视角人类录像难以转化为可学习资源、且依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，构建了覆盖经验采集、世界表示、数据自动构造、模型训练与独立评测的完整生态:HOLIWORLD-Foundry 结合静态与动态感知，自动生成把持久场景结构、物体状态演化与交互历史及观测关联起来的世界记录;约 100 个自采场景经 HOLIWORLD-Data 组织为约 8 万条 QA，用于训练 4B 的 HOLIWORLD-VL;并以人工标注的 HOLIWORLD-Bench 支持标注质量与时空理解评测。在 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Aria Digital Twin 上静态感知与动态跟踪表现强劲，用 HOLIWORLD-Data 训练后 HOLIWORLD-VL-4B 在 HOLIWORLD-Bench 与 EgoDynamic4D 上的空间与时间推理明显提升。
hf.reason: 多模态数据引擎与VLM训练扎实，但偏3D场景理解，略偏离核心方向

hf.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
hf.abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately 1.86times end-to-end inference speedup and a 66times reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
hf.titleZh: MemT-1.0:迈向记忆原生演化
hf.summaryZh: 把记忆内化为基础模型自身计算的一部分，而非外挂检索模块:基于 Metis 采用 Gated DeltaNet-2，在每轮对话内做稳定的 token 级记忆更新，并以 Mixture-of-Storage 扩展原生记忆容量;经过 backbone 预置与继续预训练、后训练两阶段流程，使用 34B token 数据训练，开源 Nano 与 Flash 两个规格。评测显示其在记忆任务上平均超过参数化记忆基线、与 RAG 方法相当，且基本保留通用能力;历史长度 128K 时，Nano 端到端推理提速约 1.86 倍，持久化存储相比全上下文 KV cache 降低 66 倍。将检索到的过程性经验内化后，agentic 任务成功率亦有提升，为记忆原生的模型演化给出可落地的一步。
hf.reason: 记忆原生架构+模型开源+智能体记忆，直击架构与Agent交叉

hf.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
hf.abstract: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.
hf.titleZh: 从机群经验中学习：一种机器人集体学习范式
hf.summaryZh: 机器人部署过程中产生的执行经验本可用于提升策略可靠性，但依赖人工遥操作监控与纠正的方式在机群规模扩大后难以维持。为此提出集体经验学习（CEL）范式：机群中的机器人共享执行经验以共同改进同一策略，并用失败引导的经验检索微调（FERT）实现——依据失败上下文从机群共享的成功经验中检索相关轨迹片段，将其动作作为监督信号更新策略，无需额外专家示范或纠正动作；配套的容错异步训练系统（FATS）在机群局部中断时协调经验收集、策略优化与分发。五个真实操作任务中，策略成功率达93.3%–99.2%，每任务120次试验且在未参与数据收集的机器人上评估；多阶段手机包装任务上用96台机器人将成功率从79.2%提升至98.3%。
hf.reason: 机器人机群学习与操作任务，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
hf.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
hf.titleZh: OpenVLHarness:面向真实世界的视觉智能体工具使用与多模态记忆
hf.summaryZh: 针对多模态模型仅靠内部推理难以获取真实世界证据的问题，在 22 个基准上的受控实验显示单纯扩大推理预算收益有限。OpenVLHarness 以能力层与持久多模态记忆为核心:能力层提供任务级工具接口与证据渲染，把异构后端输出转为模型可读观察;持久记忆将图像、结构化数据与网页引用保存为可寻址工件，并可通过编码接口在存储数据上执行程序以组合多工具结果。在 22 个基准、8 个开源与闭源骨干上，平均分较无工具基线提升 9.7–12.6 分，GPT-6 Luna 中等推理强度下超过基线最高强度、Codex 与 Visual Sketchpad 7.7–8.5 分，模型 token 成本不高于其 37%。
hf.reason: 多模态 Agent 工具调用与记忆 harness，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
hf.abstract: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. End-to-end navigation policies require diverse training data to generalize across scenes, yet real-robot data is costly to collect and simulated data leaves a sim-to-real gap. Internet egocentric videos offer a scalable source of real-world navigation experience. Our key insight is to learn goal-directed visual dynamics from Internet egocentric videos, and use these dynamics to support robot action generation. To this end, we propose ScaleNav, a unified world-action framework with three-stage training. We first perform instruction-conditioned video pretraining on these videos to learn how observations evolve as the camera approaches instructed targets across diverse real-world scenes. Action alignment then uses action-labeled simulated data to train the model to predict executable action chunks. Joint fine-tuning subsequently optimizes all trainable components together for navigation. ScaleNav achieves success rates of 86.5% on a single-view adaptation of Short-Horizon OVON and 94.9% on our HabitatGS-LN benchmark, outperforming the evaluated baselines on both benchmarks. We further deploy and evaluate ScaleNav on a real quadruped robot, with results supporting the model's ability to generalize to real-world navigation. Code and videos are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/
hf.titleZh: ScaleNav：面向语言条件局部导航的可扩展互联网视频预训练
hf.summaryZh: 语言条件局部导航要求机器人移动到初始视野中文本指定的目标处并停下，真实数据采集成本高、仿真数据存在 sim-to-real 差距。ScaleNav 从互联网第一视角视频中学习目标导向的视觉动态，构建统一的世界—动作框架并分三阶段训练：先做指令条件视频预训练，再用带动作标注的仿真数据做动作对齐以预测可执行动作块，最后联合微调全部可训练组件。在 Short-Horizon OVON 单视角适配版上成功率达 86.5%，在自建 HabitatGS-LN 基准上达 94.9%，并在真实四足机器人上完成部署验证。
hf.reason: 机器人导航方向，按画像属具身智能低分范畴

hf.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
hf.abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
hf.titleZh: SpecMRL：在参数谱内重新设计套娃表示学习
hf.summaryZh: 套娃表示学习（MRL）通过联合优化嵌套前缀来支持可变维度的嵌入，但缺乏显式约束来保证前段前缀能给出合适的紧凑编码。SpecMRL 把特征空间重组为参数导出、按特征重要性排序的谱基，前缀读取在该谱空间内完成，其余流程与标准 MRL 保持一致。在 MTEB 上，SpecMRL 在所有评测的低维设置下均优于 MRL，压缩越激进增益越大；仅用一半嵌入维度就超过了全维 MRL 的表现。这表明学习到的谱基能更好地优先保留信息量大的方向，适用于需要弹性维度嵌入的检索与存储受限场景。
hf.reason: 嵌入压缩与检索表示，沾 RAG 但非后训练主线，增量改进

hf.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.
hf.titleZh: 通过 Harness-Policy 优化实现自进化编程智能体
hf.summaryZh: LLM 编程智能体的表现同时取决于策略模型与中介其与环境交互的 harness，只优化其中一项并不理想:为旧 checkpoint 调优的 harness 未必针对更新后策略的失败模式，而固定 harness 下策略学习又受限于其诱导出的轨迹。Self-HPO 用递归自我改进框架交替优化两者:每轮由当前策略分析自身失败并提出新的 harness 候选(H 步)，再在选定 harness 下用 RL 更新策略(P 步)，训练中识别出的困难任务构成下一轮 harness 搜索集，使 harness 优化始终对准策略演化中的失败模式。在三个代码基准上，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的平均 resolve 率从 57.8% 提升到 64.8%，增益可泛化到分布外场景，Pass@1 可靠性与 Pass@k 能力前沿同步提升，且两组件联合增益超过各自增益之和;换用更强外部模型(如 Opus 4.8)担任 harness 提议者可获得进一步提升。
hf.reason: 编程智能体自进化，harness 与策略交替优化，直接命中 Agentic RL 方向

hf.title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
hf.abstract: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.
hf.titleZh: CoworkEnv：为长时程协作智能体合成训练环境
hf.summaryZh: 面向 AI 协作同事需在多轮交互中协调工具、遵循工作流约束并维护工作区状态的问题，提出能力引导的环境合成框架 CoworkEnv：以工作流需求指导任务构造，用程序化校验与反馈修复机制检查生成的规格和评分逻辑，再由教师模型执行产生示范用于 SFT、学生模型交互产生 rollout 与奖励用于 RL。基于该资源训练的 PocketWorker 模型使 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在 Claw-Eval 上平均分从 46.6 提升至 64.1，多轮任务提升 31.9 分，并验证了不同奖励处理与信用分配配置下的 RL 训练动态。工作为长时程 Agent 的可执行环境合成与 Agentic RL 训练提供了可复用路径。
hf.reason: 环境合成加 Agentic RL 训练，直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

hf.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
hf.abstract: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.
hf.titleZh: MT Forcing:让自回归扩散的多轮图像编辑更稳定、更一致
hf.summaryZh: 多轮图像编辑在几次迭代后会出现明显漂移:视觉质量不稳定、伪影累积，保留区域与先前编辑也被意外改动。MT Forcing 提出一套面向自回归扩散统一多模态模型的训练范式:单轮分布匹配蒸馏(Single-Turn DMD)用单轮内对源图施加累积编辑的教师模型监督学生自展开，避免递归误差累积;教师强制引导则在预热阶段监督参考轨迹上的历史依赖状态转移，并在蒸馏阶段作为正则项，补足逐轮分布匹配难以保证的跨轮一致性。实验显示该方法显著提升统一多模态模型的多轮编辑能力，视觉质量更稳定、跨轮一致性更强。
hf.reason: 扩散图像编辑训练方法，属低分方向

hf.title: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
hf.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly undertake long-horizon tasks in complex environments characterized by fragmented evidence, partially completed states, and dependencies across resources and artifacts. Existing agents may satisfy individual requirements while failing to maintain these relationships, producing locally correct but incomplete outcomes. These failures arise because task completion depends on relationships among environmental evidence, consequential decisions, and required effects. To address this completion gap, we propose Interlock, a framework for task synthesis that represents each task as a typed completion graph. Grounding edges connect public evidence to decisions, coupling hyperedges impose joint constraints across components, and realization edges connect decisions to all required downstream effects. Interlock compiles this graph into a resettable workspace, a public request, and an evaluation rubric. A source-coverage review checks whether the original requirements survive generation, while a public-input review checks whether the rubric is supported by the materials available to the solver. An agent-as-judge inspects execution artifacts and runs verification scripts, retaining trajectories judged to satisfy all mandatory requirements. To evaluate training utility, we fine-tune two Qwen3.6 backbones on their own accepted trajectories. Across the two backbones, training improves AutomationBench task pass rates by 4.00-4.50 percentage points, JobBench weighted scores by 3.20-6.64 points, and Harvey LAB criterion pass rates by 3.89-4.16 percentage points. These results demonstrate the training utility of the synthesized experience across external task environments.
hf.titleZh: Interlock：从局部正确到长时程智能体的任务完成
hf.summaryZh: 针对长时程智能体在碎片化证据与跨资源依赖下产生“局部正确但任务不完整”的问题，Interlock把任务表示为带类型的完成图：grounding边连接证据与决策，coupling超边施加联合约束，realization边连接决策与下游效果，并编译为可重置工作区、公开请求与评分规则。框架用来源覆盖与公开输入审查过滤任务，再由agent-as-judge检查产物并运行验证脚本，保留满足强制要求的轨迹。两个Qwen3.6骨干在各自接受轨迹上微调后，AutomationBench通过率提升4.00–4.50个百分点，JobBench加权分数提升3.20–6.64分，Harvey LAB标准通过率提升3.89–4.16个百分点，表明合成经验可迁移至外部任务环境。
hf.reason: 长时程Agent任务合成与训练，直接命中Agent方向

hf.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
hf.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.
hf.titleZh: AnyGoal：论世界模型在专家轨迹之外的泛化能力
hf.summaryZh: 世界模型要可靠地支撑规划与动作模拟，就必须在专家轨迹覆盖不到的状态-动作组合上仍然准确，而数据覆盖、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系尚缺乏系统研究。AnyGoal 从组合泛化角度切入：单个状态因子与动作都在训练支持范围内，但它们的组合在专家轨迹中出现不足，由此构建了基于常用世界模型环境的目标偏移任务基准与开源库。在多个环境与多类世界模型上，现有模型在这类重新组合下稳定出现失败；工作进一步区分动力学与表征两类失败，并比较不同交互模式与评估指标，刻画了当前世界模型能泛化到哪里、卡在哪里。
hf.reason: 世界模型组合泛化基准，属模型基 RL，与 LLM 后训练仅边缘相关

hf.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
hf.abstract: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.
hf.titleZh: 用于长上下文线性注意力的Kronecker Delta规则
hf.summaryZh: 针对线性注意力中联想矩阵记忆的delta规则更新会干扰已存信息、长上下文下记忆状态易失稳的问题，提出KronLSTM:以Kronecker Delta Rule在矩阵空间中仅沿单一方向修正目标联想，把对旧记忆的改写降到最小。该记忆动态可建模为收敛到稳态分布的马尔可夫链，且记忆矩阵的期望范数在整条输入序列上一致有界，因此无需额外归一化或稳定机制。在长上下文基准上，其表现与Gated DeltaNet等线性注意力架构相当并常优于后者，代码与模型均已开源。
hf.reason: 线性注意力记忆更新新规则，含理论保证与长上下文实验

hf.title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
hf.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.
hf.titleZh: AdaExploreBench：面向演化环境中主动探索与测试时自适应的 LLM Agent 基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准很少考察 agent 能否主动弄清环境运作方式、并在环境演化时自我调整。AdaExploreBench 将环境动态实例化为隐藏规则，要求 agent 主动采集证据并推断规则；在隐式规则漂移下潜在规则无预告地改变，agent 需从性能下降中察觉先验知识已失效并重新探索。八个前沿 LLM 上 GPT-6 Sol 校准准确率仅 61.9%，而补充充分证据或移除规则漂移可使平均性能提升近 10 个百分点，说明瓶颈在于主动获取正确证据与识别证据过期，而非基于已有证据推理。
hf.reason: Agent 主动探索与测试时自适应基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present MemPilot, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
hf.titleZh: MemPilot：为 LLM Agent 按需编排多模态记忆整理
hf.summaryZh: 现有 Agent 记忆系统多在查询无关的前提下预先构建记忆，造成不必要的预处理开销，并可能丢弃后续才显关键的细节；运行时自适应方案又常局限于固定操作或流程，难以灵活权衡性能、成本与延迟。MemPilot 通过强化学习优化多步 LLM 策略，在查询无关记忆检索与把原始多模态历史委托给异构 LLM/VLM 进行按需整理之间迭代选择，并联合控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择与视觉访问。方法按目标分别估计优势后聚合，并用基于前缀的边际效用估计做多步信用分配；在五个多模态 Agent 记忆基准上，偏好扫描给出比现有权衡基线更宽的性能、成本与延迟权衡前沿。
hf.reason: Agent 记忆与 Agentic RL 结合，系统完整、实验扎实

hf.title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
hf.abstract: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.
hf.titleZh: RoAR-VAE:通过鲁棒预测提升潜在表示的可扩散性
hf.summaryZh: 面向视觉 tokenizer 的重建保真度与下游扩散模型可学习性难以兼顾的问题，重新审视 REPA-E 后发现:去掉其扩散目标与专用生成模块、仅保留从损坏 latent 预测语义特征，在同等设置下即可获得相近的生成性能，由此提出「鲁棒预测」原则——与生成相关的信息应能从被损坏的 latent 中恢复。据此实例化 RobustAlign(从损坏 latent 预测预训练语义特征以保留高层结构)与 RobustRecon(重建干净图像以保留细粒度空间与外观信息)两个互补目标，构成 RoAR-VAE。分析表明鲁棒预测使有用信息集中到方差较高、扩散模型更易先学到的 latent 方向上;在相同训练预算下平均生成 benchmark 比最强基线 tokenizer 高 2.19 分，小文本重建准确率比 FLUX.1-VAE 高 16.93 个百分点。
hf.reason: 面向图像生成 latent 扩散的视觉 tokenizer，属低分视觉生成方向

hf.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
hf.abstract: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/
hf.titleZh: InfiniDream：通过程序化生成构建开放式逼真 3D 世界
hf.summaryZh: 针对 VLM 代码生成产出的 3D 资产过于简单、而高质量程序化系统又依赖大量人工开发的问题，构建了 VLM 驱动的开放式程序化 3D 世界生成框架。其「符号约束资产生成」复用已有程序化算法生成新颖逼真且可编辑、可由种子控制多样性的资产；端到端 text-to-world 流程将语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格放置结合，实现大规模世界搭建、精确物体摆放、程序化填充与动画。在 100 个物体与 20 个场景任务上四项感知指标均有提升，多样性分析、消融与人类偏好评测进一步验证有效性。适用于合成数据创建与游戏内容生产。
hf.reason: 程序化 3D 资产生成，属视觉生成与 3D 方向，仅因 VLM 代码生成沾边

hf.title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
hf.abstract: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
hf.titleZh: Manga2Animate：面向忠实漫画动画化的脚本与分镜规划智能体框架
hf.summaryZh: 将漫画改编为忠实原作的连贯动画，现有做法要么只以文本形式读取漫画而丢失角色与画风，要么把漫画页面直接送入视频生成模型而被误读结构、生成错误剧情。Manga2Animate 把任务拆成动画脚本与视觉分镜两种中间表示，每种表示由创建者智能体生成，再由配对的审阅者智能体对照原始分镜页核查，并配合表示特定的选择机制与双层反馈迭代精修，最后合成动画。实验与用户研究显示，该方法在忠实度与跨镜头一致性上优于现有最优方案。
hf.reason: 多智能体规划有新意，但落点是动画视频生成，偏离主线

hf.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
hf.abstract: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
hf.titleZh: HarnessPro：面向性能-成本权衡的帕累托优化递归 Harness 自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 针对递归自我改进提升 Agent harness 性能却推高执行成本的问题，提出无标签的 harness 演化方法：用 LLM 生成的测试评估候选，无需真实答案或官方测试；专用 Agent 诊断执行轨迹，按不同性能-成本优先级规划并实现候选 harness。方法通过归一化加权平方距离选择，输出偏成本（lite）、均衡（medium）和偏性能（heavy）三档 harness，并让入选者进入下一轮迭代。在 Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro 和 ProgramBench 上，GPT-5.5+Codex 的 heavy 模式相对 RHO 平均通过率提升 2.0 个百分点，单任务成本降低 26.1%，GLM-5.2+Claude Code 下同样成立。
hf.reason: Agent harness 递归自我改进与成本优化，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
hf.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.
hf.titleZh: BlenderWorld:面向真实世界参考的 3D 创作视觉智能体基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准对开放式、真实场景的 3D 创作请求覆盖不足。BlenderWorld 包含 223 个任务，横跨建筑、产品、自然环境与科学可视化，输入涵盖文本、图像、视频与结构化规格;评测时把提交的 Blender 工程从多视角渲染，用 2651 条任务专属二元 rubric 加整体视觉质量分统一打分。13 个前沿模型中 GPT-6-Astra 综合分最高(79.9),Opus-5 为 73.0、GPT-5.6-Sol 为 67.7。结果显示模型能解析粗粒度指令，但细粒度 3D 空间一致性与结构复现仍是核心瓶颈。
hf.reason: Agent 基准设计有参考价值，但 3D 创作域偏擦边

hf.title: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
hf.abstract: Robotic value models assess task execution from visual observations and instructions, providing feedback for policy learning and execution monitoring. However, existing evaluations cover only selected aspects of execution understanding, leaving the reliability of value feedback insufficiently tested. We introduce RoboValue, a fine-grained sim-and-real benchmark for unified evaluation of robotic value models. Its framework evaluates four complementary capability dimensions through shared interfaces: task-state understanding, temporal progress monitoring, failure and recovery reasoning, and value consistency. Diagnostic trajectories and instruction variations test whether value judgments accurately reflect task requirements and changes throughout execution. RoboValue-Dataset covers 15 simulation and 20 real-world manipulation tasks, providing expert demonstrations for training and annotated trajectories for fine-grained evaluation. We evaluate representative robotic value models in zero-shot and one-shot settings under standard conditions and separate shifts in robot embodiment and environment. Our results reveal errors in fine-grained instruction grounding, history-dependent progress tracking, and recovery assessment, even in models with strong outcome and forward-progress scores. The same semantic subtask can also receive substantially different value gains across valid execution orders. These findings identify concrete targets for value supervision, while the dataset and public leaderboard support continued assessment of feedback reliability. The website is available at https://robovalue-benchmark.github.io/.
hf.titleZh: RoboValue：面向机器人价值模型统一评估的细粒度虚实结合基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有机器人价值模型评测只覆盖执行理解的部分侧面，难以检验价值反馈的可靠性。RoboValue 通过共享接口在四个互补维度上统一评测：任务状态理解、时序进度监控、失败与恢复推理、价值一致性，并用诊断轨迹与指令变体检验价值判断是否准确反映任务要求及其在执行中的变化。数据集涵盖15个仿真与20个真实世界操作任务，提供专家示范与细粒度标注轨迹，在零样本与单样本设置下评测代表性价值模型，并单独测试机器人本体与环境迁移。结果显示即便是结果评分与前向进度评分较强的模型，仍在细粒度指令落地、依赖历史的进度跟踪和恢复评估上出错；同一语义子任务在不同合法执行顺序下的价值增益也可能显著不同。
hf.reason: 机器人操作价值模型基准，落在具身智能低分方向

hf.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
hf.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevantant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABCrightarrowD, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.
hf.titleZh: AffordanceWAM:面向机器人操作的可供性感知联合世界-动作建模
hf.summaryZh: 针对机器人操作中动作标注视频稀缺、人类视频缺乏动作标签的难题，提出可供性感知的世界-动作生成模型AffordanceWAM，以标量可供性与可供性热力图构成物体中心的时空可供性表示，并置于生成的未来世界之中，为动作生成提供任务相关的物体与交互区域锚点，同时充当人类视频与机器人视频共享的交互目标。模型基于预训练视频扩散Transformer，使用独立参数化的World Expert与Action Expert，通过Masked Joint Self-Attention耦合，在统一flow-matching目标下联合预测未来RGB观测、标量可供性场、可供性热力图与连续机器人动作;人类视频监督三路未来世界输出，机器人轨迹额外提供动作监督，从而无需人类动作标签或重定向即可迁移。在RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D与真实世界操作任务上均优于仅RGB与仅机器人数据基线，且在固定机器人监督下，RoboCasa性能随可供性标注人类视频规模单调提升。
hf.reason: 机器人与具身智能方向，属画像明确低分的一刀切类别

hf.title: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
hf.abstract: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) requires a model to identify an implicitly described target and predict its pixel-level mask trajectory, while resolving the spatial relations and temporal events that determine the answer. Text-only Chain-of-Thought (CoT) can explain a target choice without making the underlying visual references explicit, leaving a video reference gap between linguistic inference and the evidence distributed across frames. We introduce Temporal Chain of Video Primitives (TCoVP), a spatiotemporally grounded form of Video CoT that organizes query-relevant observations into a chronological reasoning chain. Each primitive associates an entity reference with temporal support and timestamped spatial evidence, and the chain interleaves these references with language to guide reasoning about which entity is relevant, when the queried event holds, and where its evidence appears. The selected target primitives then provide box prompts and temporal support for video mask prediction. We construct TCoVP-SFT-15k and TCoVP-RL-13k to learn this representation through supervised fine-tuning and chain-aligned reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across five VRS benchmarks and three model backbones demonstrate the strong performance of TCoVP, highlighting the effectiveness of organizing spatial and temporal evidence within the reasoning process. All models and code will be publicly released. Project page: https://victor-wjw.github.io/TCoVP/
hf.titleZh: 在空间与时间中视觉思考:面向视频分割的 grounding 推理
hf.summaryZh: 针对视频推理分割(VRS)中纯文本 CoT 无法显式指涉跨帧视觉证据、语言推理与像素级掩码之间存在参照鸿沟的问题，提出时序视频基元链(TCoVP):把与查询相关的观察组织为按时间排序的推理链，每个基元把实体参照、时间支撑和带时间戳的空间证据绑定，并与语言交替出现，以确定哪个实体相关、事件何时成立、证据在何处，再由选中的目标基元提供 box prompt 与时间支撑用于掩码预测。构建 TCoVP-SFT-15k 与 TCoVP-RL-13k，经监督微调与链对齐强化学习习得该表示，在五个 VRS benchmark 与三个骨干模型上取得稳定提升。
hf.reason: 视频推理分割与多模态 CoT 擦边，非核心后训练方向

hf.title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
hf.abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.
hf.titleZh: FineSplat:细粒度 patch、局部组与精细化 splats
hf.summaryZh: 前馈式 3D Gaussian Splatting 追求即时重建，但细粒度几何与外观难以恢复。FineSplat 以细粒度图像 patch 为单位构建前馈框架，针对高 token 分辨率下全局多视角注意力开销过大的问题，提出双分组策略:视角分组让相邻视角高效交互，3D 空间分组把几何相关的 token 提升到场景空间重新连接;同时以重建误差作为显式渲染反馈来恢复细节，并用紧凑的高斯生成方案控制基元数量。在相同或更小的高斯预算下，该方法取得了明显优于现有方法的重建质量。
hf.reason: 3DGS 场景重建，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
hf.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.
hf.titleZh: 物理RSI能力从何而来？LLM-as-policy的观测缩放定律
hf.summaryZh: 针对视觉语言模型作为操作策略时的递归自我改进（RSI）能力，构建PhysRSI-eval，以首次尝试表现、效率、成功率、预算与失败后改进五个维度量化；在固定交互预算下评测18个操作任务上的多个VLM，提出「物理木桶假说」，认为不同能力约束改进的不同环节。五维指标能区分公开基准均值接近的系统，并从公开能力预测智能体相对表现、由早期物理反馈预测后续进展两个角度建立观测缩放。工作区干预实验显示，移除历史会降低后段成功率、冻结工作区在新布局上仍有效，表明场景特化适应与可复用经验可以共存。
hf.reason: VLM操作策略的具身自我改进评测，属机器人方向，与本画像低相关

hf.title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
hf.abstract: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.
hf.titleZh: 证据优先的智能体验证
hf.summaryZh: 面向长程、半可验证的Agent任务，rubric式评判所需证据分散在环境状态与执行轨迹中，评委常遗漏证据或采信Agent自报的成功。Sauron将验证改为证据优先:同时调查状态与轨迹，任何claim须回溯源头独立核验后才采纳，并用有界查询与相关准则联合调查降低上下文开销与重复劳动，每条判定附带可审计的证据回执。在100个个人助理episode的2586条人工标注准则上，它在全部8个backbone上F1均为五个验证器中最高，且成本低于最强基线Gandalf;以GPT-5.6 Sol运行时F1达0.96(基线0.92)而成本低23%，过程类准则上优势更大。在覆盖13类故障注入(含模拟reward hacking)的配对测试中，它检出97%注入失败、仅误报2%干净对照，并在TRAIL上于三项质量指标全面领先。
hf.reason: Agent验证器兼作RL奖励，直击后训练与Agent评测核心

hf.title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
hf.abstract: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.
hf.titleZh: Fréchet Forcing：用短视频片段训练长时程流式世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 流式视频世界模型逐块生成未来，并以自身历史与动作流为条件，训练片段一短，rollout 超出训练时域后误差回灌上下文就会漂移。已有做法用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）在自 rollout 上微调，但动作条件模型缺少合格教师：外部视频模型对动作无感，自身预训练网络又会同样漂移。为此提出 Fréchet Forcing，在部署用多步采样器上一同微调，施加三项约束：以真实数据收尾的自生成历史上计算 flow-matching 生成锚定损失；对自由 rollout 的隐统计量以各片段自身真值为中心计算 Fréchet 距离，保持场景保真；在冻结感知空间中对真实帧计算 FD，保持真实感。三者均由短真实片段导出，无需教师、在线判别器与长视频。在 253 帧片段上预训练的 MiniWorld-1B 上微调不超过 36 GPU 小时，rollout 在 4000 帧以上仍稳定，并在机器人操作与相机控制探索中持续跟随动作。
hf.reason: 视频世界模型长时程训练，属视觉生成与具身方向，仅方法学略沾边

hf.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
hf.abstract: Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) depends on unsafe multimodal data for post-training alignment or activation steering. However, such data is hard to collect, must be gathered anew for each modality, and its collection and distribution raise ethical and legal concerns. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary findings confirm this ability, though effectiveness is conditioned by layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment, with the latter causing safe multimodal inputs to be spuriously steered toward refusal. Building on this, we introduce Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS), a lightweight training-free approach that injects multimodal safety without the need for multimodal safety data. MARS corrects modality misalignment via activation centering, adaptively scales steering strength within a geometrically defined trust region, and selects the optimal intervention layer, operating at the first generated token. Evaluated on five SOTA MLLMs across safety, utility, and video jailbreak, MARS achieves consistent safety gains while preserving utility up to over-refusal. MARS reveals that safety-relevant structure is shared across modalities and that textual refusal directions are a powerful and underexplored foundation for multimodal alignment.
hf.titleZh: 利用文本拒绝方向实现多模态安全
hf.summaryZh: 多模态大模型的安全对齐通常依赖不安全多模态数据，但这类数据采集困难、逐模态获取成本高且涉及伦理与法律风险。研究检验从LLM主干提取的文本拒绝方向能否跨图像、视频模态泛化，并提出免训练的MARS：通过激活中心化校正模态错位，在几何信任域内自适应调节干预强度，选择最优层并仅在首个生成token处注入安全干预。在五个SOTA MLLM上，MARS在安全、效用与视频越狱评测中取得稳定安全增益，并在不过度拒绝的前提下保持效用。结果表明安全相关结构可跨模态共享，文本拒绝方向是多模态对齐中强大却未被充分探索的基础。
hf.reason: 免训练激活干预跨模态安全，命中多模态对齐与安全方向

arxiv.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
arxiv.abstract: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.
arxiv.titleZh: 噪声下的神经算子规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对控制执行噪声下的不确定规划，提出神经算子 PUN，学习噪声感知价值场以在未见几何环境中规划。基于 screened-Poisson 随机最优控制表述，将障碍物边界由零 Dirichlet 改为反射 Neumann、仅在目标点设 Dirichlet，使采样路径能持续探索自由空间；把 Monte Carlo 求解器 Walk on Stars 扩展到高维，从含噪且部分收敛的标签中学习几何到场映射，推理时以预测场引导有界局部搜索。四个噪声水平下成功率不劣于对比方法，4D 基准达 95–100% 成功率且运行时间最低，最高噪声下成功率相对提升 10.7–60.6%、速度提升 3.29–32.15 倍。
arxiv.reason: 规划与控制类工作，与 LLM 及后训练方向无交集

arxiv.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
arxiv.abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.
arxiv.titleZh: 自适应多 Token 预测：我们应该走多远？
arxiv.summaryZh: 多 Token 预测（MTP）在单次前向中并行起草多个 token，但最优的推测长度随上下文变化：草稿可靠时更长的窗口摊销收益更高，一旦被拒绝则浪费算力，且所有头同一次前向触发，无法像自回归草稿那样逐 token 决定何时停止。工作将推测长度选择建模为在线控制问题，以「接受存活率」（草稿前缀被完整接受的概率）刻画各长度下期望提交 token 数，用轻量控制器在每轮前预测可存活距离并选取每秒期望 token 数最大的长度，无需重训练、不改动验证器。理论上证明在线学习器的预测误差可转化为相对每上下文最优长度的吞吐 regret，并进一步给出墙钟完成时间的界，在线梯度下降时 regret 为次线性。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct+Medusa、Meta MTP、Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP 等五组草稿-目标配对、AIME 2025 与 GSM8K 上，解码最高比标准解码快 4.1 倍，10 个设置中 8 个不劣于固定窗口，吞吐最高提升 10%。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码自适应推测长度，含在线控制与 regret 理论，属推理加速扎实工作

arxiv.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
arxiv.abstract: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Graph Foundation Models and the Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling, ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
arxiv.titleZh: 高效边感知注意力网络用于图生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 图生成模型常用图专用Transformer同时更新节点与边特征，却难以直接套用硬件感知的注意力实现，扩展性受限。为此提出边感知注意力层:通过逐头分数调制注入边与图级结构信息并遵守图掩码约束，同时用轻量残差机制在保留依赖注意力分数的边更新前提下更新边表示，可基于PyTorch FlexAttention高效实现。在生成质量与基线相当的情况下，峰值GPU显存降低约65%，训练与采样吞吐显著提升，为可扩展的图基础模型提供了工程可行的路径。
arxiv.reason: 图生成注意力变体与显存优化扎实，但非LLM主线且为workshop

arxiv.title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
arxiv.abstract: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves $80.88\%\pm2.56\%$ mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield $81.25\%$ accuracy and $91.32\%$ area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.
arxiv.titleZh: NarraSpace：面向图片描述式痴呆分类的多模态场景锚定证据
arxiv.summaryZh: 图片描述式痴呆分类依赖共享视觉场景，但仅凭转录级预测无法定位支撑判断的场景证据。NarraSpace将词与语音时间对齐到命名图片元素，并按预定义场景事件检索话语，用叙事-空间描述符刻画覆盖度与时间组织；再以冻结语言模型在阿尔茨海默病与健康对照样本下对比各事件文本，结合转录 surprisal 与覆盖度测量。在 ADReSS 官方48人测试集上，固定支持向量机五十个随机种子的平均准确率达80.88%±2.56%，概率平均后准确率81.25%、AUC 91.32%，且每条事件分数可回溯到源话语、语音区间与词汇匹配记录，便于临床复核。
arxiv.reason: 痴呆语音分类的垂直医疗应用，仅用冻结LLM作特征，与关注方向交集有限

arxiv.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
arxiv.abstract: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.
arxiv.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Foundational architecture paper; companion evaluation paper forthcoming
arxiv.titleZh: 面向自治系统诊断的语义可观测性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对微服务级联故障中根因定位依赖人工关键词过滤、跨仪表盘时序关联割裂的问题，把异构日志流统一建模为可查询属性图数据库，以带属性节点和有向关系表达物理拓扑、软件依赖与时间事件序列。在此之上用有向循环图编排有状态多智能体系统，沿拓扑自主导航，结合因果图算法与时间反向回溯裁剪出异常影响子图，再交由 LLM 推理引擎生成代码级根因分析与修复建议。本文仅给出系统架构、关系本体与多智能体控制环，概念性论证其可消除遥测噪声、降低 MTTR、压缩 token 消耗并抑制结构性幻觉，量化评测留待后续配套论文。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体+图结构的可观测性诊断系统，属 Agent 应用，尚无实验

arxiv.title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
arxiv.abstract: Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated & culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. However, the magnitude of this effect varies across models, with Arabic-centric models exhibiting different levels of sensitivity to localization. A mechanistic interpretability analysis shows that translated and localized variants of the same MWPs often induce distinct internal reasoning trajectories, even when aggregate accuracy remains similar. Overall, our results show that mathematical reasoning performance depends on both linguistic variety and cultural context.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向阿拉伯语方言的数学问题基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建首个方言阿拉伯语数学应用题基准 DAR-MGSM，覆盖五种主要方言与MSA，题目均需多步推理，并给出「纯翻译」与「翻译＋文化本地化」两个平行版本。在11个阿拉伯语专用与多语种大模型上评测，本地化版本准确率普遍下降，但不同模型的敏感度差异明显。机制可解释性分析显示，同一题目的两个版本常引发不同的内部推理轨迹，即便总体准确率相近。结果表明数学推理表现同时受语言变体与文化语境影响。
arxiv.reason: 属评测方法学，但聚焦方言阿拉伯语数学，与主线关联有限

arxiv.title: Value-Rich, Differently Organized: Measuring Value Expression and Organization in AI-Generated Debates
arxiv.abstract: Current evaluation of LLM-generated debate largely focuses on argumentative quality, leaving the value structure of generated arguments underexamined. We introduce a diagnostic metric framework for comparing how values are expressed and organized in human-reference and AI-generated debates. The framework separates value expression, the range of recognizable values a debate invokes, from value organization, how those values are distributed and sustained across turns. Grounded in Schwartz's Basic-10 value theory, it represents debates as multi-level value distributions over argumentative units, utterances, stances, and full debates, enabling metrics for value coverage, alignment, diffusion, and cross-turn dynamics. Across multiple generation systems, AI-generated debates are broadly value-expressive, often activating as many or more value dimensions than matched human references, but they organize these values differently. Their utterances are more locally value-diffuse, and source-blind judges distinguish value clarity from value focus. These findings show that debate evaluation should consider not only value presence, but also value organization. Code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/Maoyuan-li/Value-Expression-and-Organization.
arxiv.titleZh: 价值丰富、组织不同：衡量AI生成辩论中的价值表达与组织
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM生成辩论的评估长期集中于论证质量、忽视价值结构的问题，构建一套诊断性指标框架：以Schwartz基本价值观理论为基础，把辩论表示为论证单元、话语、立场与整场辩论的多层级价值分布，并据此定义价值覆盖、对齐、扩散与跨轮动态等指标。在多个生成系统上的实验显示，AI生成辩论的价值表达并不匮乏，激活的价值维度数量常不低于人类参照，但组织方式明显不同，单条话语层面的价值更分散。盲评裁判的判读也表明，价值清晰度与价值聚焦度是两个不同维度。这说明辩论类生成评测需同时考察价值是否出现以及如何组织。
arxiv.reason: LLM生成辩论的价值结构评测，属评测方法学但偏社科价值分析

arxiv.title: Turning TS2Vec into a Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
arxiv.abstract: TS2Vec is one of the strongest self-supervised methods for time series classification, introduced in 2022. It is designed to be trained anew on every dataset: self-supervised pre-training followed by linear probing. Since then, the field has shifted towards foundation models that reuse one encoder across datasets. Yet TS2Vec offers a compact convolutional architecture that operates directly on temporal samples and accepts variable-length inputs without resampling. We ask whether these properties can be retained when the encoder is pre-trained only once, and show that they can: TS2Vec can essentially be turned into a foundation model. Three changes suffice: pre-train on a synthetic corpus, feed the encoder a raw amplitude view and an instance-normalized shape view of the input through two small stems, and distill one specialist encoder per view into a single encoder. The result, TS2Vec-FM, is a 1.6M-parameter dilated convolutional network that, kept frozen, reaches 83.3% on UCR-128 and 75.3% on UEA-27 under linear probing, within 0.3 pp of MantisV2, the current state of the art, and above TS2Vec trained separately on each target dataset. What we find most interesting is how different TS2Vec-FM is from other foundation models in design: near-parity is reached without attention, without a patch tokenizer, and without intermediate-layer extraction, using an "old-school" convolutional encoder and a two-layer MLP stem.
arxiv.titleZh: 将TS2Vec打造成时间序列分类的基础模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对TS2Vec必须在每个数据集上重新做自监督预训练的问题，通过三项改动把TS2Vec变成可跨数据集复用的冻结编码器：在合成语料上预训练、用两个小型stem分别输入原始幅值视图与实例归一化形状视图、并把两个视图各自的专家编码器蒸馏进单一编码器。所得TS2Vec-FM是1.6M参数的膨胀卷积网络，冻结后在线性探测下达到UCR-128的83.3%与UEA-27的75.3%，距当前SOTA MantisV2仅0.3个百分点，且超过逐数据集单独训练的TS2Vec。结果说明无需注意力、patch tokenizer与中间层特征提取，仅靠卷积编码器加两层MLP stem即可接近基础模型水平。
arxiv.reason: 时间序列基础模型，与LLM主线无直接交集

arxiv.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
arxiv.abstract: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.
arxiv.titleZh: 演进式智能体接口
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对计算机使用智能体的接口由人工设计、无法跟上新应用与新模型的问题，将接口设计本身变为智能体能力：元智能体在无成功标签的合成任务轨迹上构建并修订接口与使用知识仓库，再用基于种群的演化在验证任务上筛选可泛化的仓库。在OSWorld V2上，配备Qwen3.8-27B的Agent S4取得21.3%二值得分，为固定接口的3.8倍，超过GPT-5.5（13.0%）与Claude Opus 4.8（20.6%），成本仅约4.3%与1.5%；在ScienceBoard上成功率从41.4%提升至58.6%。结果表明接口可从经验中自主演化，成为与模型和harness进步互补的提升来源。
arxiv.reason: Agent接口自主演化，OSWorld刷新SOTA，命中Agent方向

arxiv.title: What Do RTL Repair Benchmarks Actually Measure?
arxiv.abstract: RTL repair benchmarks should measure whether a model can fix broken RTL given a specification. To this end, we construct and hash-bind RTLRepairDataset, 5,784 (broken, fixed) training pairs; RTLRepairBench, 459 held-out cases with 374 syntactic and 85 behavioral mutations; and an evaluation harness supporting simulation and formal equivalence. We then use this infrastructure to identify two measurement confounds. First, simulation and formal scoring give opposite signs for the apparent effect of providing a specification in one evaluated cohort; reset-aware rescoring attributes almost all of the simulation-formal disagreement to reset and first-cycle comparison semantics. Second, on 274 mined model failures, the specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery point estimate ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points across six models. Thus, a conventional repair score need not isolate whether the model used the faulty RTL. We translate these findings into evaluation controls: report initialization, reset, first-cycle, and unknown-value semantics; disclose oracle coverage and undecided cases; and include a specification-only baseline.
