Together, the resources and audit provide both a benchmark for behavioral repair and a protocol for diagnosing what contributes to its measured score. We release the benchmark, the training set, construction code, sanitized aggregate evidence, and reproduction materials at https://github.com/Evaaaz/RTLRepairBench.
arxiv.titleZh: RTL修复基准实际测量的是什么?
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建RTL修复基准RTLRepairBench(459个留出用例，含374个语法变异与85个行为变异)与5,784对训练样本，配套支持仿真与形式化等价验证的评测框架，并审计其测量效度。发现两处混淆:给出规格说明的表观效应在仿真与形式化打分下符号相反，感知复位语义的重新打分将分歧主要归因于复位与首周期比较语义;在274个模型失败案例上，六个模型的「仅规格与规格条件」恢复率点估计跨度从-8.5到+18.3个百分点，说明常规修复分数未必反映模型是否利用了故障RTL。据此提出报告初始化、复位、首周期与未知值语义，披露oracle覆盖与未决用例，并加入仅规格基线等评测控制项。
arxiv.reason: RTL修复基准的评测效度审计，方法学有启发但落在EDA硬件域

arxiv.title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
arxiv.abstract: Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: PaPi：面向快速神经谱架构的并行 Picard-Duhamel 积分
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经谱架构（NeuSA）依赖对所学向量场做数值积分，通常采用串行 Runge-Kutta 时间步进，训练与推理缺乏时间并行性。PaPi 借鉴弱非线性流的思路，结合指数积分与 Duhamel-Picard 迭代实现时间并行推理，并证明该迭代对任意流均指数收敛，给出显式误差界，其大小取决于流与线性情形的接近程度。实验中训练与推理最高加速两个数量级，低维 PDE 学习问题的训练时间不到一秒，同时保持有竞争力的预测精度。该方法适用于频域求解时变 PDE 的场景。
arxiv.reason: PINN 求解 PDE 的数值积分加速，与 LLM 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/
arxiv.titleZh: 能干的教师，短视的打分者：面向 Agentic 同策略蒸馏的无奖励教师修复
arxiv.summaryZh: Agentic 同策略蒸馏中教师逐 token 打分，但无法预知回合终点，会放过那些“安全但拖延”的动作，而基于结果的 RL 会对这类动作判零奖励，这一“rollout-scorer gap”被指为学生耗尽回合数的真正原因。R2S 先从未训练学生的轨迹中挖掘与教师分歧最大的状态，由教师接管执行，再用共识或 LLM judge 等无奖励检查筛出足够多接管成功的状态，随后微调教师，使其在不带接管上下文的情况下从分歧回合起对每个 assistant token 给出顾及结果的分数，最后冻结为 OPD 的唯一打分者，修复与训练全程不使用任务奖励。在三个环境、两个教师、四个学生的 12 个组合上全面超过三个 SOTA agentic-OPD 方法，平均成功率高出最佳基线 12.8 个百分点。该工作把“教师能力”与“教师打分质量”解耦，为缺少可验证奖励的 Agent 蒸馏提供了可复用范式。
arxiv.reason: Agentic 同策略蒸馏的教师打分修复，直击后训练核心问题

arxiv.title: Beyond the Sequentiality Bottleneck: A Hybrid Diffusion-Autoregressive Framework for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Autoregressive models (ARMs) face a "Sequentiality Bottleneck" in reasoning, while diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallelism but lack semantic coherence. To addresses both limitations, we propose Collaborative Reasoning Asymmetric Learning (CoRAL), a hybrid framework via an Asymmetric Planner-Executor (APE) architecture: a DLM Planner generates K diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel, while a large ARM Executor selects the optimal plan and synthesizes the final answer. To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越串行性瓶颈：面向高效多模态推理的混合扩散-自回归框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对自回归模型推理时的串行瓶颈与扩散语言模型并行但语义连贯性不足的问题，提出混合框架 CoRAL：其非对称 Planner-Executor 架构中，扩散语言模型 Planner 并行生成 K 条多样化推理轨迹，规模更大的自回归 Executor 选出最优规划并合成最终答案；配套的奖励引导 CoT 去噪（RDC）把结果奖励注入扩散过程，使去噪朝目标导向推理方向偏移。在视觉-语言基准上，该方法显著优于既有扩散类方法，与强自回归模型相比质量具竞争力且效率更高。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型做推理规划，沾LLM推理与效率但属扩散低分向，给边界分

arxiv.title: Continuous-Time Policy Gradient from Discrete Data: Convergence Analysis and Model-Free Algorithms
arxiv.abstract: Continuous-time reinforcement learning seeks an optimal policy under unknown dynamics driven by stochastic differential equations using observations collected at discrete times. We develop a policy gradient framework that combines rigorous convergence analysis with learning from discrete data. We first establish a performance difference lemma and derive policy gradient formulas for randomized and parametrized policies. We then prove exponential convergence of an entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum. For discrete parametrized updates, we derive a convergence bound that explicitly separates the contributions of critic error, policy-regression error, and the learning step size. To enable learning under unknown dynamics, we integrate this framework with PhiBE, which constructs a continuous-time surrogate generator from discrete transition data. The resulting on-policy and off-policy model-free actor-critic algorithms preserve the continuous-time structure of the control problem. Numerical experiments on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot demonstrate the performance and stability of the proposed methods with both known and data-driven dynamics.
arxiv.titleZh: 从离散数据出发的连续时间策略梯度：收敛性分析与无模型算法
arxiv.summaryZh: 连续时间强化学习需要在未知 SDE 动力学下、仅凭离散时刻观测求解最优策略，而既有策略梯度理论多依赖连续观测与已知动力学。为此建立性能差引理，给出随机化策略与参数化策略的策略梯度公式；证明熵正则化策略流以指数速率收敛到正则化最优解；对离散参数化更新给出显式分离 critic 误差、策略回归误差与步长贡献的收敛界；并与 PhiBE 结合，由离散转移数据构造连续时间代理生成器，得到保持连续时间控制结构的 on-policy 与 off-policy 无模型 actor-critic 算法。在熵正则化线性二次调节器与非线性轮式机器人上的实验验证了方法在已知与数据驱动动力学下的性能与稳定性。
arxiv.reason: 连续时间控制 RL 理论，与 LLM 后训练及 Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
arxiv.abstract: In this report, we introduce Sage-A1.5, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that builds on A1 to advance long-horizon problem solving through adaptive capability composition. Compared with A1, Sage-A1.5 learns not only to solve individual tasks, but also to organize work and revise its approach during execution. Sage-A1.5 highlights three improvements: agentic orchestration, verification, and open scientific discovery. First, agentic orchestration extends single-agent execution through task delegation and parallel collaboration among subagents with isolated contexts, enabling complex tasks to be decomposed and addressed concurrently and supporting efficient execution while reducing interference across concurrent subagents. Second, agentic verification strengthens long-horizon reliability through progress checking, evidence validation, and reflective strategy revision, allowing the agent to recognize unproductive search paths and pursue alternative approaches. Third, open scientific discovery extends agentic capabilities beyond answering predefined questions to conducting exploratory research, connecting scientific inquiry with interactive analysis and inspectable research artifacts. We showcase these capabilities through complicated agentic tasks and multidisciplinary scientific applications. Besides, we hope Sage-A1.5 provides the community with an accessible foundation for open scientific discovery, offering a practical path from long-horizon task execution to collaborative, verifiable, and inspectable scientific exploration.
arxiv.titleZh: Sage-A1.5:从长程任务执行到能力组合的科学探索
arxiv.summaryZh: 35B MoE 智能体模型 Sage-A1.5 在 A1 基础上转向能力的自适应组合:不只求解单个任务，还要在执行过程中组织工作并修正策略。三项改动为:通过子智能体之间的任务委派、隔离上下文与并行协作实现多智能体编排;用进度检查、证据校验和反思式策略修订提升长程可靠性;把能力从回答既定问题扩展到开放科学探索，产出可交互的分析过程与可检视的研究产物。论文以复杂智能体任务和多学科科研应用进行展示，未报告量化指标，并开放模型 checkpoint 与 token plan。
arxiv.reason: 35B MoE 智能体模型技术报告，命中 Agent 编排与 AI for Research

arxiv.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 Agent 的缓存工程
arxiv.summaryZh: Agent 轨迹变长后，KV cache 的读写与存储成为主要开销；而用裁剪或摘要压缩历史会改动轨迹前缀，使后续缓存失效并触发昂贵的重预填充，保留上下文过少又损害准确率。为此提出 cache engineering：agent 直接对活跃 KV cache 施加 drop（把选中的 cache 排除在未来注意力之外）与 repos（调整保留 key 的位置编码），在不改轨迹、不重预填充的前提下控制缓存；并指出同一 token 序列在不同操作序列下缓存状态不同，前缀匹配不足以正确复用，进而协同设计 AKV 服务引擎，对外提供无状态接口、内部管理有状态复用与驱逐恢复。工具响应滚动丢弃策略使平均 benchmark 提升 1.7 分、平均成本降低 27.7%，AKV 带来最高 1.2 倍输出吞吐与 1.5 倍 P95 延迟加速，递归自我改进的缓存策略较专家设计再降 7.1% 成本。
arxiv.reason: KV cache 直接操作加推理引擎协同设计，命中系统效率与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token
arxiv.abstract: Energy-efficient deployment of large language models requires understanding how model architecture, hardware, and serving settings shape energy per generated token. We introduce the Token-Energy Law, a compact, interpretable model of GPU-board energy per output token for dense, full-history decoding. It relates token energy to two core dimensions: active bytes and realized decode time. Active bytes describe logical byte demand per output, separating dense weights shared within a decode iteration from private key--value (KV) histories read and updated for each request. Realized decode time is the elapsed decode duration divided by the number of output tokens produced. We combine the two byte coordinates and time in a common affine form, with coefficients calibrated for each model and hardware/runtime configuration. This formulation explains how batching amortizes shared-weight work, longer attended histories increase private KV demand, and throughput determines the time-associated cost per output. Our experiments cover three models under BF16 decoding on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, including two-GPU tensor parallelism on Hopper. Using fixed coefficients and observed decode time, held-out condition-mean energy estimates differ from measurements by at most 3.73%.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM解码的Token-能量定律：活跃字节与实际解码时间解释每Token焦耳
arxiv.summaryZh: 每输出Token的GPU板级能耗如何随模型架构、硬件与服务配置变化，仍缺少可解释的定量刻画。Token-Energy Law用活跃字节（区分解码迭代内共享的稠密权重与每请求读写的私有KV历史）和实际解码时间（解码总时长除以输出Token数）构建统一仿射模型，并按模型与硬件/运行时校准系数，解释批处理摊薄共享权重、长历史抬高私有KV需求以及吞吐影响时间成本。在NVIDIA Hopper与Blackwell上对三个模型做BF16解码（含双GPU张量并行），留出条件下平均能耗估计与实测偏差不超过3.73%。
arxiv.reason: 解码能耗建模直击推理效率与KV cache，系统测量扎实

arxiv.title: Evolving Semantic Indexes for Generative Retrieval
arxiv.abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs). SID design largely determines GR quality, but its discrete, interdependent components (SID construction, collision handling, decoding, and training) cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. We introduce a framework that improves these components through LLM-driven evolutionary program search, to our knowledge the first application of this approach to GR. A locally served, open-weight 31B model mutates executable GR components, so no proprietary LLM API is used, and a 1M-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1B target generator. Across 21 SID programs on NQ320K, proxy and target Recall@100 show strong rank correlation (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$). Guided by this proxy, evolution improves the seed GR on NQ320K, MSMARCO300K, and a multilingual e-commerce dataset under a fixed training recipe. On NQ320K, jointly evolving SID construction and collision handling improves Recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and Recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. A component study shows that proxy reliability depends on what is evolved: improvements transfer reliably for the semantic index but not for the generator's training objective or the full pipeline. LLM-driven evolutionary search is thus a practical tool for GR design, provided proxy reliability is established for the chosen search space.
arxiv.titleZh: 为生成式检索演化语义索引
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式检索（GR）把检索与推荐建模为离散语义标识（SID）的自回归生成，但SID构建、冲突处理、解码与训练等离散组件无法用梯度端到端优化，仍靠人工设计。该工作用本地31B开源模型驱动进化式程序搜索变异可执行的GR组件，并以百万参数代理解码器替代反复训练1B目标生成器给出快速反馈，21个SID程序上代理与目标的Recall@100排序相关性达Spearman ρ=0.90。在代理引导下，NQ320K上联合演化SID构建与冲突处理把Recall@1从55.8%提到59.3%、Recall@100从85.8%提到90.6%，MSMARCO300K与多语电商数据同样受益；但改进仅在语义索引上可靠迁移，训练目标和整条流水线不成立。
arxiv.reason: LLM进化程序搜索用于生成式检索的SID设计，方向擦边、方法有新意

arxiv.title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
arxiv.abstract: Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers. In a two group linear model, we identify an initialization region in which greedy routing makes collapse self reinforcing. We then derive finite horizon error dynamics showing how routing interventions can reverse collapse by repeatedly training the starved model, primarily with updates from its compatible group. Motivated by this condition, each client uses blocked EXP3 to choose between greedy routing and interventions that redirect updates toward unused models. Experiments show that with simpler predictors and faster specialist formation, autonomous controller selection recovers usable specialists from unfavorable starts that trap standard CFL baselines. In transformed FEMNIST, the synchronized-entry configuration with persistent commitment recovers usable specialists in settings where the autonomous controller configuration often does not. Code and scripts for reproducing the experiments and figures are available at https://github.com/prsinha1/FedRecover.
arxiv.titleZh: 聚类联邦学习中的坍缩与恢复动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: 聚类联邦学习在不利初始化下会出现簇坍缩:早期路由把异质客户端挤到同一模型，另一模型得不到更新，而路由又由当前模型决定，形成自我强化的失败循环。工作把该过程建模为未知动力系统的控制问题——簇模型为状态、客户端路由为控制输入、路由干预为状态依赖控制器;在两组线性模型中刻画出贪婪路由导致坍缩自强化的初始化区域，并推导有限时域误差动力学，说明反复用相容组的更新训练被饿死的模型即可逆转坍缩。据此每个客户端用blocked EXP3在贪婪路由与重定向干预之间自主选择。在变换后的FEMNIST上，该自主控制器能从困住标准CFL基线的糟糕初始点恢复出可用的专家模型，并观察到更简单的预测器与更快的专家成型。
arxiv.reason: 联邦聚类路由与动力学控制，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: Asymmetric Bidirectional Predictive Dynamics in Google Search and COVID-19 Time Series: A Multi-Horizon Forecast-Error Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Online search activity is widely used as a digital trace of information seeking during epidemics, but its predictive value is often reduced to correlation, a selected lag, or a single forecast-error score. We examine eight pre-specified Google Trends-COVID-19 pairs in both directions using matched LightGBM forecasts over rolling 400-day windows and horizons of 1-14 days. Log-RMSE gain is combined with forecast-error distribution entropy (FEDE), which captures horizon-dependent changes in the signed error distribution. The resulting directional predictive signature comprises response class, RMSE effect, FEDE endpoint and early-slope responses, persistence across rolling regimes, and horizon profile. For screening candidate directions, we also introduce a relative persistence-weighted directional predictive response strength (DPRS) on a within-study 0-100 scale; 100 denotes the strongest observed response in the comparison set, not an absolute coupling maximum. The pairs show concordant, RMSE-only, FEDE-only, and mixed responses. "loss of smell" -> reported cases is accuracy-dominant, with mean log-RMSE gain 0.104 (about 9.9% equivalent RMSE reduction) and DPRS 100, whereas the reverse direction is FEDE-dominant (D_FEDE=0.048; DPRS=42). "covid test" -> positive rate is FEDE-dominant (D_FEDE=0.039; positive in 72% of windows; DPRS=98) despite negative RMSE gain, while "lockdown" -> stringency is the clearest concordant case (DPRS=78). World-level symptom/case pairs are less persistent. Thus, forecast accuracy and error-distribution dynamics are complementary, predictive effects can be direction- and metric-dependent, and forecast horizon is part of the relationship. Aggregated regime-level patterns should not be extrapolated to individual time points or interpreted as evidence of causality.
arxiv.titleZh: Google 搜索与 COVID-19 时间序列中的非对称双向预测动力学：多预测时域的预测误差分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察 Google Trends 与 COVID-19 指标之间的双向可预测性，而不只是报告相关系数或单一误差分数。针对 8 组预先指定的搜索与疫情时间序列，在 400 天滚动窗口、1–14 天的预测时域上，用设置相匹配的 LightGBM 做双向预测，以对数 RMSE 增益结合预测误差分布熵（FEDE）构成方向性预测特征，并提出 0–100 的持续性加权响应强度 DPRS 用于筛选。结果中，“loss of smell”→报告病例以精度为主（对数 RMSE 增益 0.104，约合 9.9% 的 RMSE 下降，DPRS 100），反方向由 FEDE 主导；“covid test”→阳性率为 FEDE 主导，但 RMSE 增益为负。这说明精度与误差分布动力学互补，效应随方向与时域变化，聚合结论不能外推到单个时间点或视为因果。
arxiv.reason: 疫情时间序列与搜索趋势的统计预测分析，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
arxiv.abstract: Many scientific phenomena are best understood as outcomes of underlying optimization problems, yet automated scientific discovery has largely focused on recovering equations that describe observed input-output patterns. We introduce OptScientist, a novel automated framework for discovering compact symbolic optimization laws directly from data. OptScientist comprises (i) a model that infers symbolic optimization problems by first learning to represent data as an optimization problem and then extracting its symbolic form, and (ii) an LLM agentic system embedding the model in a discovery process that integrates theoretical priors from scientific literature, discovers candidate laws, abstracts their underlying mechanisms, and suggests new data to collect. We first evaluate OptScientist on OptFeynman, a novel benchmark of 99 physics-derived optimization problems, where OptScientist recovers ground-truth laws for over 80% of the problems and remains robust to noisy contextual information, while substantially outperforming machine-learning, symbolic, and LLM-based model-discovery baselines. On human risky choice and central-bank monetary policy, OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that achieve held-out predictive performance competitive with leading baselines, while using few parameters and substantially fewer tokens than LLM baselines. Overall, OptScientist extends automated scientific discovery to uncovering optimization laws that generate observed phenomena, enabling automated theory building across the physical, biological, behavioral, and social sciences.
arxiv.titleZh: OptScientist:自动发现优化定律
arxiv.summaryZh: 科学现象常可视为某个优化问题的解，但自动化科学发现此前多停留在拟合输入输出方程，而非还原生成现象的优化结构。OptScientist 由此提出直接从数据中提取紧凑符号优化定律的框架:一个模型先把数据表示成优化问题、再抽取其符号形式;外层 LLM 智能体系统则引入文献中的理论先验、发现候选定律、抽象其机制并建议补采数据。在 99 个物理导出的优化问题基准 OptFeynman 上，该方法对超过 80% 的问题还原出真值定律，并对噪声上下文保持稳健，显著优于机器学习、符号回归与基于 LLM 的基线;在人类风险选择与央行货币政策任务上，其学到的符号定律以极少参数取得与强基线相当的留出预测性能，且 token 消耗远低于 LLM 基线。该工作把自动发现从方程拟合推进到优化定律层面，为物理、生物、行为与社会科学提供可自动化的理论构建路径。
arxiv.reason: LLM 智能体驱动的科学定律发现，命中 AI for Research 方向

arxiv.title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
arxiv.abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is the cornerstone of modern deep learning, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain poorly understood in non-convex settings. To address this gap, we study SGD dynamics in deep linear neural networks - simplified models that retain key non-convex characteristics while remaining analytically tractable. Building on recent results for gradient descent, we extend convergence guarantees to SGD under regularized squared loss. We establish almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates. Using the framework of asymptotic pseudotrajectories from stochastic approximation theory, our analysis establishes then, for both deterministic and adaptive step-size choices, convergence of SGD to the set of critical points under mild conditions (without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data). To our knowledge, this is the first work providing almost sure convergence guarantees for SGD in deep linear networks, bridging the gap between theoretical optimization and practical stochastic training.
arxiv.titleZh: 随机梯度下降学习线性神经网络的收敛性
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究深度线性网络在正则平方损失下 SGD 的几乎必然收敛性。先证明 SGD 迭代的几乎必然有界，再借助随机逼近理论中的渐近伪轨迹框架，在确定性与自适应步长两种设置下证明 SGD 收敛到临界点集合，且不依赖 Lipschitz 性质或白化数据假设。这是首个给出深度线性网络 SGD 几乎必然收敛保证的工作，为理解实际随机训练的优化行为提供理论依据。
arxiv.reason: 纯优化理论研究，与 LLM 后训练等工程方向仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Agentic Ensemble with Vision-Language Models for Visual Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Visual anomaly detection aims to detect abnormal objects, while anomaly samples are often scarce during model training. Assembling multiple pretrained detectors can help by leveraging their transferable image scores and anomaly maps. However, most existing ensemble methods apply fixed fusion rules over saved predictions which struggle when pretrained detectors clearly disagree due to different training objectives, priors, and visual representations. To this end, we design AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework for accurate visual anomaly detection. AnomalyAgent aligns heterogeneous scores and maps, summarizes score- and region-level disagreement, and treats fusion as a finite action-selection problem. It implements two types of actions: 1) score actions that determine how to fuse image-level detector confidence via consensus, robust aggregation, detector weighting, or score-map consistency; 2) map actions that fuse dense anomaly responses via consensus, detector weighting, geometric aggregation, or disagreement correction. A constrained vision-language model (VLM) is introduced to inspect high-conflict samples and select valid score action and map action to produce the final prediction. We evaluate AnomalyAgent on MVTec AD and VisA as primary benchmarks, together with seven additional public anomaly benchmarks and Real-IAD for large-scale score-level evaluation. Across these benchmarks, AnomalyAgent consistently improves over equal-weight fusion and achieves the best mean image AUROC and pixel AP among the compared fusion methods on MVTec AD and VisA, while demonstrating robust transfer across additional anomaly domains.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向视觉异常检测的视觉语言模型智能体集成
arxiv.summaryZh: 视觉异常检测中异常样本稀少，常需集成多个预训练检测器，但现有方法多用固定融合规则，难以应对检测器因训练目标与先验不同而产生明显冲突的情形。AnomalyAgent 是一个后训练融合框架:先对齐异构的图像级分数与异常图，汇总分数级与区域级分歧，再把融合建模为有限动作选择问题——分数动作包括共识、稳健聚合、检测器加权与分数-图一致性，图动作包括共识、检测器加权、几何聚合与分歧校正，并由受约束的VLM检视高冲突样本、选择有效的分数动作与图动作给出最终预测。在 MVTec AD 与 VisA 上取得对比融合方法中最佳的平均图像 AUROC 与像素 AP，并在另外七个公开异常基准与 Real-IAD 上稳定优于等权融合。
arxiv.reason: 工业视觉异常检测的检测器融合框架，借VLM做动作选择，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Large Flow Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.
arxiv.titleZh: 大规模流语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 把连续流(flow)语言模型推到十亿参数规模，解决其大规模训练与推理技术尚不成熟的空白。Lafa 采用分块流式设计:块间对前缀做因果注意力，块内为双向异步流，因而能直接改造预训练自回归模型，并用前缀缓存与块级并行解码加速推理;在 0.5B、7B、8B 三档上各用不到 30B token 完成训练。在指令遵循、推理与代码任务上，流式建模质量与 AR 持平或更优，并可蒸馏为 flow map 实现单步与少步生成;流训练还借多 token 预测效应保留甚至提升原 AR 能力，据此设计的自投机解码在同等质量下达到 AR 的 2.54 倍吞吐。

arxiv.title: When Do LLMs Help with Feature Selection? A Systematic Empirical Study
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods. We investigate this question within an 18-dataset framework comprising 10 datasets for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) training, 2 for checkpoint validation, and 6 held-out evaluation datasets. We compare five classical baselines, frozen Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B selectors, and two GRPO-adapted Qwen2.5-7B models, reporting classification ROC-AUC and regression R^2 separately and using dataset-wise ranks for cross-task comparison. Across five seeded evaluation partitions, classical selectors generally achieve higher predictive performance than the tested 7B LLM/RL selectors, including under a pre-specified ~33% feature budget with strict train-only classical fitting, while the 7B selectors retain compact subsets. A cardinality-matched semantic sensitivity experiment shows that, for Zero-shot Qwen-7B, informative feature names improve regression performance over anonymized and shuffled alternatives (+0.1964 and +0.1606 mean R^2), whereas aggregate classification differences are smaller (+0.0159 and +0.0084 ROC-AUC) and dataset-dependent. These results characterize when semantic information benefits LLM-based feature selection and show that classical selectors remain strong baselines for predictive tabular feature selection.
arxiv.titleZh: LLMs 何时有助于特征选择?一项系统性实证研究

arxiv.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习计算结构以实现样本高效的预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 高维学习常常受维度灾难的困扰；组合稀疏函数能让样本复杂度只取决于局部变量数量，但梯度训练能否自动利用这类隐藏结构，目前缺乏理论保证。CSFRBench 是一个受控基准，训练时隐藏目标计算图、诊断时保留，它显示稠密网络和基于稀疏性的基线都未能充分利用这一收益。Learned Wiring（LeWi）为每个神经元学习一个低维嵌入，只让邻近神经元连接，并将嵌入与权重联合训练：在 32 个独立采样计算图生成的目标上，LeWi 的学习曲线面积均值比稠密网络低 27%；在控制、导航、操作等 17 个世界模型预测任务中，LeWi 在 16 个任务上优于稠密基线，在 119 组比较中赢了 99 组。

arxiv.title: Discount Yourself: Self-inclusive Freshness-weighted Gossip for Decentralised Learning under Client Outages
arxiv.abstract: Decentralised federated learning (DFL) trains personalised models on devices that average with their neighbours rather than with a central server. Real devices, however, are often offline for hours or days, and a client returning from an outage can recover only by aggregating the models its neighbourhood holds. We observe that the stalest of these models is usually the client's own, a case that existing staleness-aware rules, which discount only the models a client receives, do not address. We formalise aggregation after an outage as estimating the state of a fully available network and derive three principles. First, the receiver must be discounted like any neighbour. Every rule that weights it at least as much as each neighbour has an error that grows without bound with the outage, whereas discounting all candidates by relative staleness keeps the error bounded. Second, staleness must be measured as inherited lag rather than age, since local training resets a model's age but not the lag it absorbed from stale neighbours. We introduce the effective lag, which tracks this quantity at the cost of one scalar per message. Third, the discount must be steep, because absorbed lag persists in every later round. These principles define Self-inclusive Freshness-weighted Gossip (SFG), a family of drop-in aggregation rules with the communication and computation of decentralised federated averaging, whose guarantees hold for the stale receiver itself. On three image benchmarks and eight outage processes, including real smartphone availability traces, the lag-based members SFG-L and SFG-Cut consistently outperform decentralised federated averaging and recent age-of-information rules, and ablations show that each principle is necessary. The analysis also explains why tuned limited merging from gossip learning is effective.
arxiv.titleZh: 折扣自身：客户端中断下用于去中心化学习的自包含新鲜度加权 Gossip
arxiv.summaryZh: 去中心化联邦学习中，客户端离线数小时乃至数天后只能靠聚合邻居模型恢复，而邻居中最陈旧的往往正是自己的模型，现有陈旧度感知规则只折扣收到的模型，对此无效。该工作把中断后的聚合形式化为对完全可用网络状态的估计，提出三条原则：接收方须与邻居一样被折扣；陈旧度应以「继承滞后」而非年龄度量，并给出每消息仅一个标量的 effective lag；折扣必须足够陡。由此得到 SFG 系列即插即用聚合规则，通信与计算开销和去中心化联邦平均持平，且保证覆盖陈旧的接收方自身。在三个图像基准与八种中断过程（含真实手机可用性轨迹）上，SFG-L 与 SFG-Cut 稳定优于去中心化联邦平均与近期 age-of-information 规则，消融显示三条原则各自必要。

arxiv.title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
arxiv.abstract: Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the hardest instances, while remaining competitive on language modeling (Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption kernel can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.
arxiv.titleZh: 二元离散扩散：面向逻辑与规划任务的候选集扩散
arxiv.summaryZh: 掩码式与均匀离散扩散在单次加噪中即抹去 token 身份，噪声状态无法显式表达多个候选并存的部分不确定。为此提出二元离散扩散：以每个位置的候选 token 集合为噪声状态，用二元成员向量表示，通过候选的加入与移除实现信息的逐步丢失与恢复，并在连续时间下给出对称与非对称两种加噪核。在 Sudoku-Extreme、Boxoban 与图着色任务上，对称形式在架构、训练与采样预算匹配的条件下稳定优于强基线，且实例越难增益越大；在 Text8、TinyStories、OpenWebText 上语言建模仍具竞争力。

arxiv.title: Humans Correct Their Judgments Through Debate, but Weaker AI Models Do Not
arxiv.abstract: How can we effectively oversee AI systems that surpass human intelligence? AI Safety via Debate proposes that two AI systems argue opposing positions and a judge, either a human or a weaker model, decides which is correct. By facilitating supervisors in providing high-quality training signals, debate aims to encourage truthful and safe behavior from AI systems whose capabilities exceed our own. However, human judgment is not neutral: people often rely on biases which advanced AI systems may learn to exploit. Drawing on insights from collective intelligence and social cognition, this paper investigates whether debate can guide human and LLM supervisors toward the truth despite their prior beliefs. We evaluate several protocol configurations. We also explore setups inspired by the wisdom of the crowd such as the number and diversity of judges, as well as interaction mechanisms including deliberation and voting. Overall, we find that debate increases accuracy relative to prior beliefs for human judges, whereas the consultancy baseline, in which a single expert argues for one answer, does not. For weaker language models, however, the results are mixed: debate provides no comparable gains in most settings and can even reduce accuracy. Among multi-judge protocols, weighted voting produces the highest accuracy for human supervisors, whereas for LLMs none of them significantly improves group accuracy, even as the number of judges increases. Notably, the behavior of minority judges in non-diverse deliberation protocols suggests that, under symmetric settings, incorrect positions could be more persuasive than correct ones. These findings support debate as a viable path toward scalable human oversight, but cast doubt on its benefits for weaker AI supervisors, raising concerns about fully automated training and control pipelines in high-stakes settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 人类能通过辩论修正判断，但较弱的 AI 模型不能
arxiv.summaryZh: 检验 AI 辩论协议（两个模型对辩、人类或更弱模型裁判）能否让裁判克服先验信念、给出更准确的监督信号。工作比较多套协议配置，并引入群体智慧式设计：裁判数量与多样性、审议与投票等交互机制。结果显示，人类裁判辩论后准确率高于其先验信念，单一专家论证的 consultancy 基线则无增益；较弱语言模型上结果混杂，多数设置无相当增益甚至准确率下降；多裁判协议中加权投票对人类最优，对 LLM 则无论裁判数量都无显著提升；非多样性审议中少数派行为提示错误立场可能更具说服力。支持辩论作为可扩展人类监督路径，同时对高风险场景的全自动训练与控制流水线提出警示。
arxiv.reason: 可扩展监督与辩论式评测，贴近对齐与LLM-as-judge，但非训练主线

arxiv.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
arxiv.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. Furthermore, at a short recovery budget, calibration and recovery data are coupled. The best recovery data depends on the calibration data, so the two must be chosen jointly. The resulting recipe involves a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and an inexpensive codebook-only recovery stage. Including codebooks, it uses about $2.3$ effective bits per weight and retains $89$ to $97\%$ of full-precision question-answering (QA) accuracy where scalar PTQ is at chance, and, including recovery, uses $1.4$ to $30\times$ less compute than the strongest quantization-aware-training (QAT) baseline.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越4比特：以数据为中心的后训练量化与恢复
arxiv.summaryZh: 2比特标量PTQ会跌至随机水平，而量化表示、校准数据与恢复微调数据这三项常被当作无关紧要的实现细节。该工作在6个3.8B–32B的稠密与MoE模型上系统比较后发现：表示方式影响最大，向量码本能在标量PTQ完全失效处恢复出可用模型；剩余精度损失主要集中在生成任务，且下降幅度与模型相关；短恢复预算下校准数据与恢复数据相互耦合，必须联合选择。据此给出的配方为向量码本、小型任务对齐校准混合与低成本仅码本恢复，约2.3有效比特，保留89%–97%的全精度QA准确率，恢复算力比最强QAT基线少1.4–30倍。

arxiv.title: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
arxiv.abstract: Decision models support routing, guardrails, and output verification in LLM systems. However, item accuracy alone cannot establish whether models make correct decisions across controlled variations or assign reliable confidence to their predictions. We introduce DecisionPivot, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 48 tasks and 40,033 items across seven decision roles. Its core track contains 7,800 items from 13 generated task families, organized into contrast groups with computed answers verified by independently implemented solvers. The complementary reference track contains 32,233 items from 35 public test sets, preserving their original evaluation metrics. We evaluate 40 decision models and 14 general models using documented, model-specific protocols, assessing item and contrast-group accuracy, probability ordering, calibration, and empirical selective coverage. Our results reveal substantial differences obscured by aggregate scores: two 27B models separated by only 2.6 points on the reference track achieve contrast-group accuracies of 70.1% and 44.2%. Across 2,400 binary contrast pairs, Perplexity Decider correctly ranks the positive member above the negative member in 92.3% of pairs but answers both members correctly in only 74.1%, exposing a gap between probability ordering and decision correctness. Models with similar item accuracy also differ in the reliability of their high-confidence predictions. On a separate 1,296-item subset, GLM-5.3 achieves 93.5\% contrast-group accuracy at a higher reasoning setting, compared with 81.5% at its lowest effort. By linking errors to pivotal details and difficulty levels, DecisionPivot provides fine-grained diagnostics of decision failures that aggregate evaluation alone cannot reveal.
arxiv.titleZh: DecisionPivot：面向 LLM 系统中决策模型的诊断性基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 单条目准确率无法判断 LLM 决策模型在受控变化下是否做对决策、置信度是否可靠。DecisionPivot 包含 48 个任务、40033 条数据与七种决策角色：核心轨道 7800 条来自 13 个生成任务家族，按对比组组织，答案经独立求解器校验；参考轨道 32233 条取自 35 个公开测试集。在 40 个决策模型与 14 个通用模型上评测对比组准确率、概率排序、校准与选择性覆盖：参考轨道仅差 2.6 分的两个 27B 模型对比组准确率为 70.1% 与 44.2%，2400 个二元对中 Perplexity Decider 排序正确率 92.3% 但两个条目同时答对仅 74.1%，GLM-5.3 提高推理强度后由 81.5% 升至 93.5%。错误被定位到关键细节与难度层级，提供聚合评测无法揭示的细粒度诊断。
arxiv.reason: LLM 决策与路由基准，评测维度设计扎实，命中评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: GraphCast-Mamba: Learning Non-Markovian Corrections for Weather Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Unresolved atmospheric processes can introduce history dependence beyond the short input windows used by many weather forecasting models. We introduce GraphCast--Mamba, which augments a frozen, pretrained $1^\circ$ GraphCast backbone with a trainable Mamba correction branch combining graph message passing and Mamba layers. The branch retains a temporal memory state across successive six-hour forecast steps, learning corrections informed by temporal context beyond GraphCast's two-frame input. Training is confined to the correction branch, using ERA5 data from 2015--2021. After 2,500 optimizer updates, including warm-up, the selected model achieves substantial improvements relative to the uncorrected GraphCast backbone. It reduces the GraphCast loss (normalized weighted mean-squared error; MSE) by 14.42% when aggregated over the full ten-day forecast and by 21.66% at day 10 (240 h after forecast initialization). At this final forecast lead time, root-mean-square error (RMSE) decreases by 7.09--14.60% across all 11 evaluated variable groups, spanning temperature, wind, pressure, geopotential, specific humidity, and precipitation. These results demonstrate broad improvements in ten-day weather forecasts through a short correction-training schedule while retaining the pretrained backbone.
arxiv.titleZh: GraphCast-Mamba:为天气预报学习非马尔可夫修正
arxiv.summaryZh: 数值天气预报模型受限于短输入窗口，无法刻画未解析大气过程带来的历史依赖。该工作冻结预训练的1° GraphCast 主干，外接一条由图层消息传递与 Mamba 层组成的可训练修正分支，并在连续六个小时的预报步之间保留时间记忆状态，从而利用超出两帧输入的历史上下文生成修正项;训练仅更新该分支，使用2015–2021年 ERA5 数据、约2500次优化器更新。结果显示，十天聚合的归一化加权 MSE 降低14.42%，第10天(240小时)降低21.66%;在该预报时效上，温度、风、气压、位势、比湿与降水共11个变量组的 RMSE 下降7.09%–14.60%。这说明用极短的修正训练即可在保留预训练主干的前提下，系统性提升十天预报精度。

arxiv.title: ECG for laboratory values:A comprehensive physiological and technical analysis
arxiv.abstract: Laboratory measurements are essential for clinical decision making but typically require invasive blood sampling. Recent research suggests that ECG recordings may contain information beyond cardiac rhythm and provide information related to laboratory values. This thesis investigates NT-proBNP prediction from ECG recordings and patient metadata using a multimodal deep learning framework, while considering the physiological plausibility of ECG-based prediction. It also compares a 1-lead configuration using lead II with the corresponding 12-lead configuration. Additional experiments on glucose, hemoglobin, and potassium are presented in the appendix. Regression, binary classification, and three-class classification experiments were conducted using MIMIC-IV, with the three-class task based on clinically established thresholds. The 12-lead configuration consistently achieved better performance. Regression reached a mean absolute error of 534.98 pg/mL for 1-lead and 514.27 pg/mL for 12-lead. Binary classification achieved AUROCs of 0.849 and 0.876, respectively, while three-class classification achieved macro-averaged AUROCs of 0.738 and 0.752. The results indicate that precise NT-proBNP regression remains challenging, whereas broader concentration ranges can be classified more effectively. The findings are consistent with the physiological hypothesis that ECG characteristics and NT-proBNP concentrations reflect shared cardiovascular processes. ECG-based NT-proBNP prediction may therefore provide complementary information, particularly for classifying broader concentration ranges. However, laboratory measurements remain necessary, and validation on independent datasets is required.
arxiv.titleZh: 用 ECG 预测实验室检验值：生理学与技术层面的综合分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决的是实验室检验值通常依赖有创抽血的问题，探索从 ECG 信号与患者元数据中预测 NT-proBNP 的可行性，并检验其生理合理性。采用多模态深度学习框架，在 MIMIC-IV 上开展回归、二分类与基于临床阈值的三分类实验，同时对比单导联（II 导联）与 12 导联配置。12 导联始终更优：回归 MAE 为 514.27 pg/mL（单导联 534.98 pg/mL），二分类 AUROC 为 0.876（单导联 0.849），三分类宏平均 AUROC 为 0.752（单导联 0.738）。结果表明精确回归仍困难，但较宽的浓度区间分类更有效，ECG 预测可提供互补信息，仍不能替代检验且需独立数据验证。

arxiv.title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP
