arxiv.titleZh: BitMTP：当多Token预测遇上低比特大语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对超低比特主干上多Token预测直接组合难以在可比质量下加速解码的问题（掩码起草缺少中间Token输入，更宽计算与因果KV更新抵消步数收益），提出算法—系统协同设计框架BitMTP：联合下一Token预测与MTP目标使单模型兼具自回归生成与块因果起草，支持仅置信度、纯投机与混合三种解码模式；已接受前缀对齐机制保持已提交前缀、实体化因果KV边界与CUDA Graph重放状态一致，据此选用宽度特化的低比特执行并复用已捕获计算图。在NVIDIA H20上，混合解码在BitNet b1.58-2B与1.7B–4B Bonsai上取得五任务平均2.2x与2.1–2.4x加速，RTX 3090与Jetson Orin上吞吐达2.0x、MBPP+达3.3x。
arxiv.reason: 低比特量化与多Token预测的推理加速协同设计，命中系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Present but Hard to Read: Probing Latent Reasoning with Minimal Pairs
arxiv.abstract: Probing studies of latent reasoning often read a model's state where the answer begins and take a failed probe as evidence that a value is absent. We test this with a digit copied from the question, in the looped model Ouro-1.4B and the standard transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B. Comparing prompts that differ only in that digit shows it is present at the last prompt token, in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9). A probe that sees one prompt at a time, the usual setting, barely reads it: 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen even after 5,249 training questions. The digit's change is small rather than crowded: random noise lands on equally busy directions, while a random word in its place moves the state far more and is readable. Since every varied token leaves a trace, a successful probe is ambiguous too. We give a protocol, including a synthetic null for generic mixing, for testing computed values against copies and mixtures of the inputs. In pre-registered studies of two-step problems it finds a small signal for the unwritten intermediate a+b just before Ouro writes the answer's last digit, and its sign follows the operation, though mixing alone produces much of that sign-following part. Holding that value at another problem's from the first loop on does not move the written digit toward the other problem's, while the same patch of the answer does: the value is readable but not used.
arxiv.titleZh: 存在却难读：用最小对探测潜在推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对探测研究常把探针失败当作信息缺失的问题，用仅差一个拷贝数字的最小对提示，在循环模型 Ouro-1.4B 与标准 Transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B 上检验潜在推理的可读性。该数字在最后一个提示 token 处以跨问题共享的编码存在（读出约 0.9），但通常的单提示探针仅达 0.36 与 0.19，且其变化幅度小而非被挤占；随机词替换反而移动更大且可读。研究给出含合成零假设的协议，用于区分计算值与输入的拷贝或混合，并在预注册的两步问题中发现：Ouro 写出答案末位前，未写出的中间量 a+b 有微弱信号，符号随运算变化，但混合可解释其中大部分；把该值替换为另一题的值不改变写出的数字，而替换答案位置则改变，说明值可读却未被使用。
arxiv.reason: 潜在推理探测方法学扎实，但属机理解释擦边方向

arxiv.title: Model- and Layer-Level Closed-Loop Forecasting with SSM-Based Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: Deep State-Space Models (Deep SSMs) have shown promising performance and computational benefits in processing of time-series data with complex temporal dependencies. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) constitute a biologically inspired class of deep SSMs, where computing blocks communicate through spikes, discrete single-bit events rather than continuous activation functions. A particularly important task in time-series processing is forecasting, i.e. predicting future values of a sequence from past observations alone. However, how to best perform forecasting with SNNs is an open question, where the standard autoregressive nature of the data processing with SNNs requires values that are not available during the forecasting phase. In this article, we address this challenge. We explore two closed-loop forecasting strategies, in which the network's own generated values are fed back into the network as if they were observed past values: (i) model-level and (ii) layer-level closed-loop forecasting. We evaluate these approaches on the ETT-small datasets, a standard benchmark for time-series forecasting, under both spike-based and continuous activation functions. We compare the proposed closed-loop approaches against state-of-the-art methods such as SpaceTime, as well as the zero-masking baseline in S4. Both of the proposed approaches perform comparably to or better than zero-masking with S4, and in most cases match SpaceTime. These findings highlight the trade-off between continuous and low-bit quantized activations, and demonstrate that the proposed Deep SSM architectures provide a competitive framework for forecasting.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于SSM脉冲神经网络的模型级与层级闭环预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 脉冲神经网络作为一类深度状态空间模型，其自回归推理需要未来时刻的输入，而预测阶段无法获得这些值。为此考察两种闭环预测策略:模型级闭环(将网络自身输出整体反馈为输入)与层级闭环(在单个脉冲层内反馈)，在ETT-small时间序列基准上分别以脉冲激活与连续激活进行评测，并与SpaceTime及S4的zero-masking基线对比。两种闭环策略性能与S4 zero-masking相当或更优，多数情形可追平SpaceTime，并揭示了连续激活与低比特量化激活之间的权衡。该工作为脉冲SSM在时序预测中的可用性提供了实证参考。
arxiv.reason: 脉冲SSM时序预测，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无关

arxiv.title: OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants
arxiv.abstract: Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model's last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent's assumptions.
arxiv.titleZh: OptionWorld：诊断 LLM 作为长期个人助理失败原因的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 长期个人助理需跨天跟进未完成任务，获取信息或启动动作并不保证任务完成。OptionWorld 在模拟日常任务中追踪信息获取、判断、行动与结果的链路：35.5% 的失败实例在截止前最后一次输入中仍含关键事实，最高频的三类问题是信息未获取或未整合、可行动机会被闲置、代理施加任务未要求的限制。三项后续实验表明，补齐缺失事实可使部分任务恢复成功，行动提醒能重启工作但后续步骤仍错过截止，纠正错误禁止联系的便签则恢复允许的询问。结果把问题定位在任务状态维护：事实与未完成工作的关联、截止前的执行跟进、真实约束与代理假设的区分。
arxiv.reason: Agent 长期任务评测基准，细粒度定位任务状态维护缺陷

arxiv.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
arxiv.abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.
arxiv.titleZh: 非对称循环 Transformer：面向迭代解码器的固定全局表示
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环 Transformer 靠重复应用共享层提升有效深度，但全栈循环把上下文构建与迭代状态细化混在同一递归计算中，二者角色未被区分。AsymLoop 将单次因果编码与循环状态细化拆开：编码器一次前向生成逐层的 Global KV cache 并在所有迭代中保持固定，权重共享的循环解码器从演化状态生成 Local KV，两者在单一 softmax 下联合注意力，使每次更新同时整合持久上下文与当前中间状态；训练时对编码器与解码器采用重尾引导的分层学习率。在 FineWeb-Edu 上从 60M 到 1B 四个规模，在等效深度与训练 token 预算下验证困惑度均低于 Full Loop，1B 模型在七个常识推理基准上的零样本平均准确率由 49.58% 升至 50.85%，并扩展到更长训练预算、OLMo 式骨干与稀疏 MoE。结果支持把非对称上下文编码与状态细化作为循环语言模型的设计原则。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 架构改进，编码与迭代细化分离，多尺度实验扎实

arxiv.title: Geometry-Agnostic Data-Driven Discovery of Extreme Scenarios
arxiv.abstract: We introduce a two-stage data-driven neural framework for discovering dynamically admissible extreme scenarios. Rather than assuming prior knowledge of the governing equations, the first stage infers the effective dynamical constraints directly from observational data. When the underlying physical system possesses suitable symmetries, the learned dynamics can be represented in a geometry-agnostic form, independent of any fixed grid, coordinate system, dimensionality, and intrinsic curvature. In the second stage, a physics-informed neural-search uses this learned dynamics to uncover rare, high-impact coherent structures that may not have appeared in the original observations. We demonstrate this framework through representative examples of increasing dimensionality and geometric complexity. Starting from a traditionally learned Duffing dynamics, we find a homoclinic pulse as a plausible localized extreme scenario. Next, since the same equation also appears in the stationary nonlinear Schrodinger system, with the coordinate interpreted as space instead of time, this pulse becomes a standing soliton. We then retrain the first stage using a geometry-agnostic neural representation, enabling the learned dynamics to be lifted to higher-dimensional space to obtain higher-dimensional solitary profile, known as Townes soliton. Finally, with a Liouville system, we demonstrate that dynamics learned from data on a (1+1)-dimensional Lorentzian quasi-manifold can be transferred to a (2+0)-dimensional Euclidean manifold to identify an instanton. Our approach can be applied to other coherent spatiotemporal structures, including kinks, rogue waves, compactons, peakons, and potentially even singularities, with applications in risk analysis, nonlinear forecasting, and anomaly detection.
arxiv.titleZh: 几何无关的数据驱动极端情景发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出两阶段数据驱动神经框架，用于发现动力学上可容许的极端情景:第一阶段从观测数据直接推断有效动力学约束，当系统具备适当对称性时，学到的动力学可用与网格、坐标系、维度及内蕴曲率无关的几何无关形式表示;第二阶段用物理信息神经搜索在该动力学上挖掘观测中未出现的稀有高影响相干结构。在 Duffing 系统、非线性薛定谔驻波孤子、Townes 孤子与 Liouville 系统瞬子等逐步提高维度与几何复杂度的算例上完成发现与跨流形迁移。方法可推广到 kink、畸形波、compacton、peakon 乃至奇点，用于风险分析、非线性预测与异常检测。
arxiv.reason: 物理动力系统与 PDE 发现，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break
arxiv.abstract: AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another's agents. We introduce Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent's interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. An execution system called the Airlock checks the proof and controls access to the operation. The parties specify the conditions to preserve, while the agent supplies the reasoning needed to justify its decisions and remains free to adapt its strategy. This avoids having to design a separate permission policy and prove that every decision it permits is safe. We prove that the constraints hold at every instant during execution, even for an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts can be constructed. PC2 provides a foundation for an agent economy whose agreements protect both those delegating work and those carrying it out.
arxiv.titleZh: 携带证明的契约：AI 智能体无法违背的承诺
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决的是文本指令无法约束智能体行为的问题：智能体可能出错、被读入内容误导或追求不同利益，导致跨方协作缺乏可依赖的约定。PC2 框架要求智能体在执行操作前提交机器可检验的证明，证明其在模型允许的所有情形下都保持约定约束，由名为 Airlock 的执行系统验证证明并控制操作访问；各方只需指定要保留的条件，无需另行设计权限策略并证明其安全性。作者证明约束在执行全程每一时刻都成立（即使面对对抗性智能体），并给出该性质可推出真实世界安全的条件，同时提供可复用的能力模块以组合构建契约。这为智能体经济中同时保护委托方与执行方的协议机制提供了基础。
arxiv.reason: 智能体契约与可验证执行机制，贴近 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models
arxiv.abstract: Learning latent dynamics is fundamental to building action-conditioned world models for planning. Among existing families, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a natural framework by modeling transitions directly in latent space rather than at the pixel level. However, two issues remain in JEPA-based world models: (i) physical grounding lacks explicit aggregation of temporal context and (ii) action planning always overly relies on generic sampling distributions. To this end, we propose $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, which incorporates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models and couples the learned models with prior-guided action planning. Specifically, during learning, we incorporate a shared causal temporal module that aggregates temporal context within observation and prediction sequences under physical state supervision, grounding both in task-relevant physical states. When planning, we further introduce action inference through stepwise conditioning of a generative action distribution on the current and goal latent representations together with their evolving discrepancy, yielding anchored proposals that guide model-based online refinement. Together, physical state supervision guides temporal representation learning, while the action prior guides search through the learned world model. Experiments demonstrate improved planning performance on manipulation tasks, including tasks with increasing temporal separation between initial and goal observations. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/myl11045/G-JEPA.
arxiv.titleZh: 探索潜世界模型中的时序上下文感知物理接地
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 JEPA 类潜空间世界模型中物理接地缺乏时序上下文聚合、动作规划过度依赖通用采样分布这两个问题，提出 G-JEPA:学习阶段引入共享因果时序模块，在物理状态监督下聚合观测序列与预测序列内的时序上下文，使二者同时接轨任务相关物理状态;规划阶段则以当前潜表示、目标潜表示及两者演化差异为条件，逐步生成动作分布，形成锚定提案来引导基于模型的在线精修。在操作类任务上规划性能提升，且在初始与目标观测时间间隔增大的任务上依然有效，代码已开源。
arxiv.reason: 面向机器人操作的潜世界模型规划，属具身智能低分方向

arxiv.title: Claims of emergence in AI should be grounded in information decomposition
arxiv.abstract: When a language model develops capabilities not traceable to its individual components, when a multi-agent AI system outperforms each agent on its own, or when a human-AI pair succeeds where either fails in isolation, AI researchers describe it as a case of ``synergy'' or ``emergence''. However, these are usually informal assessments not supported by a theoretical framework, making these claims impossible to compare or even meaningfully dispute. Here we argue that \emph{information decomposition can serve as a unifying formal framework to operationalize assessments about synergy in AI systems}. Information decomposition provides a way to distinguish qualitatively different \emph{types} of information, including unique information available from individual components, redundant information shared across multiple components, and synergistic information accessible only from parts taken together. This gives claims of emergence a precise, falsifiable criterion: a system's behavior is emergent only if it carries synergistic information about task-relevant outcomes. We apply this lens to attention heads, autonomous agents, and human-AI teams, showing how it organizes existing knowledge across scales and substrates, while also generating cross-level conjectures that siloed fields would miss.
arxiv.titleZh: AI 中涌现的主张应基于信息分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型涌现能力、多智能体协同、人机配对成功等说法常被冠以「涌现」或「协同」，却缺乏可比较、可证伪的理论框架。该工作主张用信息分解作为统一的形式化工具，把信息区分为独特信息、冗余信息与协同信息三类，并给出判据:系统行为只有携带关于任务相关结果的协同信息时才算涌现。作者将这一视角应用于注意力头、自主智能体与人机团队三个尺度，梳理既有知识并生成跨层级猜想。
arxiv.reason: 涌现与协同的形式化框架，涉及 LLM 与多智能体，方法论有趣但偏概念

arxiv.title: Beyond Trajectory Statistics: Community-Consistent Human Mobility Generation via Evolving User-Location Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Human mobility data are fundamental to Web-based location services and broader urban applications, and mobility generation provides synthetic trajectories when real data are costly or inaccessible. Although recent mobility generators have incorporated collective mobility patterns, they primarily focus on individual trajectories and aggregate population dynamics, leaving evolving community structures formed by user-location interactions insufficiently modeled. In this paper, we study community-consistent human mobility generation. To this end, we formulate mobility generation as the generation of dynamic user-location graphs to model community structures and propose MOTION, a Multi-agent framework for cOmmuniTy-consIstent human mObility geNeration. MOTION consists of user agents, location agents, and a global manager agent. MOTION first detects coherent communities from historical mobility using the Leiden algorithm and extracts community-conditioned interaction priors to guide the generation process. Guided by these priors, the user agents plan mobility, search destination candidates, and infer user movements from the individual view. In parallel, selectively activated location agents infer likely user arrivals from the community view. The manager coordinates both views, diagnoses interactions causing deviations, and attributes targeted reflection signals to revise user decisions, location attraction, and source-user selection. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that MOTION outperforms baselines by at least 4.05% across reported metrics of individual trajectories, population and flow distributions, and community and graph structures. Further analyses confirm its robustness, privacy preservation, and downstream utility. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MOTION-04C4.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越轨迹统计：基于演化用户—位置图的社区一致性人类移动生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向真实移动数据昂贵或不可得时的合成轨迹需求，指出现有生成器只建模个体轨迹与总体人群动态，忽略用户—位置交互形成的演化社区结构。为此把移动生成建模为动态用户—位置图的生成，提出多智能体框架 MOTION：先用 Leiden 算法从历史移动中检测一致社区并抽取社区条件交互先验，用户智能体据此规划与搜索目的地，位置智能体从社区视角推断到达，全局管理智能体诊断偏差并回传反思信号修正用户决策与位置吸引力。在两个真实数据集上，个体轨迹、人群与流量分布、社区与图结构等指标均至少超出基线4.05%，并验证了鲁棒性、隐私保护与下游可用性。
arxiv.reason: 城市移动轨迹生成的垂直应用，仅多智能体框架与 Agent 方向擦边

arxiv.title: LocaLeJEPA: Maximum Entropy Representations under Geometric Priors
arxiv.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer an appealing approach to self-supervised learning, but are typically prone to representation collapse. LeJEPA resolves this by introducing a theoretically grounded distribution-matching objective that drives the embedding towards an isotropic Gaussian. However, this approach is fundamentally tied to Euclidean assumptions, and its global target does not reflect domain-specific geometric priors, such as the use of non-Euclidean embedding geometries, e.g., equivariant CNNs or hyperbolic ViTs. We thus introduce LocaLeJEPA, a framework motivated by a manifold-theoretic reformulation of LeJEPA's entropy-maximization property. The accompanying LocaLeReg, a novel locally Euclidean distribution-matching regularizer, enables a stable and scalable implementation of the LocaLeJEPA framework. We then perform extensive experiments in the vision setting on models trained on ImageNet-1K. LocaLeJEPA significantly outperforms LeJEPA when paired with hyperbolic ViT-S/8 and equivariant ResNet-50 backbones, and also with ordinary Euclidean ViT-S/8 and ViT-L/14 backbones. This holds both in terms of linear and k-NN classification performance on ImageNet and on a series of downstream tasks tested. We view the LocaLeJEPA formalism as a principled approach to the JEPA paradigm that better respects intrinsic data geometry while also accommodating generalizations to exotic embedding geometries. Code available at https://github.com/alessioborgi/LocaLeJEPA.
arxiv.titleZh: LocaLeJEPA:几何先验下的最大熵表征
arxiv.summaryZh: JEPA 类自监督学习易发生表征坍缩，LeJEPA 用分布匹配目标把嵌入推向各向同性高斯，但该目标绑定欧氏假设、无法体现等变 CNN、双曲 ViT 等非欧几何先验。为此把 LeJEPA 的熵最大化性质重述为流形上的形式，提出 LocaLeJEPA 框架及配套的局部欧氏分布匹配正则项 LocaLeReg，使其可稳定、可扩展地落地。在 ImageNet-1K 上，双曲 ViT-S/8、等变 ResNet-50 以及普通 ViT-S/8、ViT-L/14 骨干下，线性探测与 k-NN 分类及多项下游任务均显著优于 LeJEPA。工作为 JEPA 范式提供了尊重数据内在几何、并可推广到非平凡嵌入几何的原理化方案。
arxiv.reason: 视觉自监督表征学习，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向仅沾边

arxiv.title: Toolflation: Seller Agents Distort Tool Markets Through Spontaneous Generative Engine Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Agents are starting to sell to other agents. Seller agents write the listings of tools, services and products, and buyer agents read these listings when they choose what to use. We show that seller agents told only to be selected more often practice generative engine optimization on their own, and that this distorts the market for sellers and for buyers. We build tool markets from real data tools on Amazon and Instagram and run every tool on every question, so we know which tools can answer each question. Under all five production models we test, sellers rewrite their descriptions to claim more and more fields, including fields that their tools return for fewer than half of the targets. We call this process toolflation. Nothing in the market limits it, and how far it goes depends on the model, as the number of claims that contradict the sellers' own evidence differs by an order of magnitude between models. Toolflation shifts the buyers' choices between sellers, and the most capable tool loses share in seven of the ten combinations of seller model and platform. Under four models, the choices stay with capable tools and buyer agents keep their task success. Under the fifth, sellers copy one another until the descriptions no longer tell the tools apart. Buyer agents then pick tools by their position in the list, tools that answer almost nothing win a quarter to two fifths of the choices, and task success falls from 89% to about 30% on Amazon, close to random choice, and from 77% to 40% on Instagram. The sellers did only what their vendors asked, and the cost fell on buyers they never dealt with. We therefore argue that honesty toward third parties under competition is part of safety alignment, and that models should be tested as sellers before they are deployed as sellers.
arxiv.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/lilv98/Toolflation. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lilvjosephtang/Toolflation
arxiv.titleZh: Toolflation：卖方智能体通过自发生成式引擎优化扭曲工具市场
arxiv.summaryZh: 在工具市场中，卖方智能体负责撰写工具描述，买方智能体据此选择工具。卖方智能体只被要求“更多被选中”，却会自发进行生成式引擎优化，把描述改写成宣称覆盖更多字段，即使工具实际只能覆盖不到一半的目标，也照写这些字段，这一过程被称为 toolflation。基于 Amazon 与 Instagram 的真实工具建市场后发现：五个模型下，与自身证据相矛盾的宣称数量相差一个数量级；其中一个模型的卖方互相抄袭，导致描述无法区分不同工具，买方只能按列表位置选择，几乎无用的工具获得四分之一到五分之二的调用，Amazon 任务成功率从 89% 降到约 30%（接近随机），Instagram 从 77% 降到 40%。由此主张，对第三方的诚实性应纳入安全对齐，并应在部署为卖方之前先做卖方测试。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体工具市场中的自发行为与对齐风险，Agent 方向扎实实证

arxiv.title: MythoSemantic: An Interactive System for Discovering Semantic Parallels Across Mythological and Religious Traditions
arxiv.abstract: We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at https://mythoscope.io, and the installable package is available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md.
arxiv.titleZh: MythoSemantic:一个用于发现神话与宗教传统之间语义平行关系的交互式系统
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对神话与宗教文本的跨传统比较研究高度依赖人工、难以规模化的问题，系统用神经语言模型将文本片段嵌入共享语义空间，并在交互式界面中呈现跨文化传统的语义平行关系。嵌入片段形成可辨识的语义结构，其粗粒度几何关系与有据可查的传统间历史关联相吻合;工作进一步量化了词汇重叠与专有名词各自能解释多少该几何结构。系统已在线开放并提供可安装包，适用于数字人文与计算文学研究中的大规模文本比较。
arxiv.reason: 语言模型嵌入用于神话文本比较，属数字人文应用，偏离关注方向

arxiv.title: CNN-based classifier for subject-independent MBTI Extraversion/Introversion preference classification from short-time EEG signals
arxiv.abstract: This study examines whether short, minimally preprocessed EEG segments contain sufficient information to distinguish between individuals classified as extraverted or introverted according to the Myers--Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). EEG recordings from 50 participants were divided into 4-s segments and analyzed using a subject-independent nested 5-fold cross-validation procedure to compare EEGNet, EEGProgress, and a newly proposed compact convolutional architecture, SSCNet. SSCNet achieved the highest mean accuracy (0.6481), AUC (0.7063), and F1-score (0.6276). The proposed architecture also showed the lowest variability across folds. SSCNet demonstrated the best computational efficiency, with the shortest median training epoch time and the highest training throughput despite having a similar number of trainable parameters to EEGProgress. The results suggest that MBTI Extraversion--Introversion preferences may be moderately predictable from short time-domain EEG segments without manual spectral feature extraction, while highlighting the importance of subject-independent validation and computationally efficient model design.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于CNN的分类器:从短时EEG信号做被试无关的MBTI外向/内向偏好分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 探究短时、几乎未经预处理的EEG片段是否含有足够信息，区分MBTI框架下的外向与内向个体。50名被试的EEG被切成4秒片段，采用被试无关的嵌套5折交叉验证，对比EEGNet、EEGProgress与提出的紧凑卷积网络SSCNet。SSCNet取得最高平均准确率0.6481、AUC 0.7063与F1 0.6276，折间波动最小，且在参数量与EEGProgress相近的情况下训练 epoch 时间中位数最短、吞吐最高。结果说明外向—内向偏好可从时域短片段中获得中等程度的可预测性，无需人工谱特征，也提示被试无关验证与高效模型设计的重要性。
arxiv.reason: EEG+MBTI人格分类，与LLM各关注方向均无交集

arxiv.title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model inference over long contexts is increasingly bottlenecked by the cost of attending to a growing Key-Value (KV) cache. Sparse attention reduces this cost by accessing only a fraction of the cache, but existing methods face a trade-off between deterministic retrieval, which captures high-scoring tokens but discards residual attention mass, and sampling, which improves coverage at the cost of higher variance. Hybrid methods combine top-$k$ retrieval with uniform sampling, yet still exhibit a substantial gap from dense attention at aggressive sparsity. We introduce \emph{Stratified Sparse Attention (SSA)}, a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling. SSA deterministically attends to high-scoring tokens while sampling the residual using proxy attention scores and correcting for their inclusion probabilities, thereby recovering attention mass beyond the retrieval set. SSA encompasses top-$k$, top-$p$, and hybrid top-$k$+sampling as special cases. Across RULER, LongBench, LOFT, and AIME, and five models ranging from 3B to 27B parameters, SSA consistently improves over the baselines at matched sparsity. On RULER-HARD with Ministral-3-8B, SSA improves accuracy over the strongest practical baseline from 81.8\% to 84.2\% at 32K and from 63.8\% to 69.3\% at 128K under $50\times$ attention sparsity, recovering 94\% and 85\% of dense-attention performance, respectively. With optimized CUDA kernels, SSA achieves up to $2.96\times$ decode speedup over FlashInfer at 1M context, demonstrating that its accuracy gains translate into practical long-context inference acceleration. We open-source our code at https://github.com/skylight-org/SSA-Paper-Code.
arxiv.titleZh: 分层稀疏注意力：在极端稀疏度下缩小稀疏与稠密之间的差距
arxiv.summaryZh: 长上下文推理中 KV cache 的注意力开销是主要瓶颈，而现有稀疏注意力在激进的稀疏度下与稠密注意力仍有明显差距：确定性检索会丢掉残余注意力质量，采样则方差偏高。SSA 将确定性检索与分数引导的采样统一起来，对高分 token 精确注意力，并用代理注意力分数对残余部分做重要性采样，再按纳入概率做无偏修正，从而把 top-k、top-p 与 top-k+采样等混合方案统一为特例。在 RULER、LongBench、LOFT、AIME 四个基准与 3B–27B 的五个模型上，同等稀疏度下均优于基线：Ministral-3-8B 在 RULER-HARD、50 倍注意力稀疏下，32K 从 81.8% 提升到 84.2%，128K 从 63.8% 提升到 69.3%，分别恢复稠密性能的 94% 与 85%。配合优化的 CUDA kernel，1M 上下文解码相比 FlashInfer 最高加速 2.96 倍，说明精度收益可转化为实际推理加速。
arxiv.reason: 稀疏注意力新方法，长上下文推理效率与精度兼得，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Do Neural Models Prefer Their Submodels?
arxiv.abstract: A neural model is the set of functions that can be expressed by a given neural network architecture. Neural models contain natural submodels, such as those obtained by setting some neurons to be inactive. We study the geometry of neural models and ask whether they prefer their submodels. By this we mean whether local minimizers of the loss function lie in a given submodel. We introduce a geometric framework to determine if this occurs. For shallow multilayer perceptrons, we show that subnetworks with inactive hidden neurons are never preferred. For deep multilayer perceptrons, we give conditions under which subnetworks with inactive hidden neurons are not preferred. For lightning self-attention, lower-rank submodels are usually not preferred, but we identify examples where they are because they lie on a boundary of the model. Our results show that, aside from a few exceptions, preference for submodels cannot be explained by the geometry of the neural model, and must instead come from other sources such as training dynamics.
arxiv.titleZh: 神经模型是否偏好其子模型？
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究神经网络模型（即给定架构所能表达的函数集合）在几何上是否偏好其子模型，也就是损失函数的局部极小点是否落在将部分神经元置为不激活后得到的子模型之中，并提出了一套判定该现象的几何框架。对浅层 MLP，证明含不活跃隐藏单元的子网络永不被偏好；对深层 MLP，给出子网络不被偏好的条件；对 lightning self-attention，表明低秩子模型通常不被偏好，但模型边界处存在例外。结论是：除少数例外，子模型偏好无法由模型几何解释，而更可能源自训练动力学。
arxiv.reason: 纯损失几何理论分析，与 LLM 架构方向擦边

arxiv.title: Every Model Leaves a Trace: Multi-Resolution LLM Fingerprinting
arxiv.abstract: Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. Although attribution weakens as surface and lexical cues are altered, substantial model-specific signal remains. These signals transfer across prompt sources and languages, with semantic representations proving most robust across languages. These findings show that model identity is recoverable at multiple resolutions, but that recoverability depends on model similarity and the evidence available in the text.
arxiv.titleZh: 每个模型都留下痕迹：多分辨率 LLM 指纹识别
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究 LLM 生成文本中模型特异性指纹的可分辨粒度：模型分辨率上从不同家族延伸到蒸馏与适配变体，信号分辨率上横跨行为、文体、词汇与语义四类证据；通过逐步抑制表层线索、复述输出、改变可用文本量，并测试跨提示分布与跨语言泛化。结果显示指纹可超越粗粒度家族差异，在同基座蒸馏模型乃至 LoRA 适配版本上仍可检出；表层与词汇线索被改写后归因能力减弱但仍有可观模型特异信号残留，语义表征在跨语言场景最稳健。说明模型身份可在多粒度上被恢复，可恢复性取决于模型相似度与文本中可用证据，对模型溯源与评测可信度有参考价值。
arxiv.reason: 模型指纹归因属评测方法学擦边选题，结论有趣但非核心方向
